name: Undocumented field (SL01)
description: Opaque SL-family feature bit with no descriptive suffix. BMW ships this name verbatim with no further documentation; purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Confirmed genuine BMW token from sysetshellevo descriptor table; 'SL' prefix is the SpeedLock/software-lock family; no enum names defined; consumed by HMI/Jacinto process, not OMAP.

name: Spanish/ES market variant flag (SL02_ES)
description: SL-family flag with suffix 'ES', indicating a Spanish or ES-market variant feature. Active when FA option 807 (Japanese version) is set — suggesting this flag enables certain ES-variant features even on Japan-spec vehicles. Token suffix 'ES' is the authoritative market designator from the firmware descriptor.
notes: Token SL02_ES from sysetshellevo; resolved_unnamed confirms 'ES' = Spanish/ES market suffix. FA gate is 807 (Japanese version), which is the activation condition, not the token meaning. Confidence remains med due to the unusual ES-suffix + Japan FA gate combination.

fa_gate: NOT 609 Professional navigation system / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Cover Flow album browser (entertainment)
description: Enables the Cover Flow album-art browsing mode in the entertainment system. Active when Professional navigation (609) is not fitted and the car is not the China country-control variant (8LH).
notes: Token ENT_COVERFLOW; default on; FA gate excludes 609 Professional nav and 8LH country control.

fa_gate: NOT 609 Professional navigation system / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Cover Flow via USB
description: Enables Cover Flow album-art browsing specifically for media played from a USB device. Companion bit to ENT_COVERFLOW; same FA gate (excludes 609 Professional nav and 8LH).
notes: Token ENT_COVERFLOW_USB; default on.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL05)
description: Opaque SL-family bit with no descriptive suffix and only NICHT_AKTIV (not active) as its documented state. Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL05; enum has NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV.

name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 1
description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the first of three such locks. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / 810 Australian version / 838 Canadian version / 8AA Chinese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 2
description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the second of three such locks. Enabled at the factory for the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838 or S8AA). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Manual number entry (SL08_NUMMEREINGABE)
description: Enables manual number/digit entry input mode in the HMI, typically for entering phone numbers or codes via the iDrive controller. Active for Japanese market (807).
notes: Token SL08_NUMMEREINGABE; 'Nummereingabe' = German for 'number entry'; FA gate = 807 Japanese version.

name: Undocumented reserved bit (byte 1, bit 0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. The firmware acknowledges this bit position (bare magic word in sysetshellevo) but ships no name string and no consumer reads it in the OMAP image.
notes: Not in syset_fielddict; no name pointer; Neighbors: SL10/SL11/SL12/SL13/SL14/SL15/SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL10)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL10; enum has NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL11)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL11; no enum names in syset.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL12)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL12; no enum names in syset.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL13)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL13; no enum names in syset.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL14)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL14; no enum names in syset.

name: Undocumented feature flag (SL15)
description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token SL15; no enum names in syset.

fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Allow adding CE devices (SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE)
description: SL-family flag enabling the option to add consumer-electronics (CE) devices such as additional Bluetooth or media accessories. Active for Japan, Australia, Canada, China markets, and certain vehicle type-key groups.
notes: Token SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE; 'ADD_CEDEVICE' = add consumer-electronics device; no enum names in syset.

name: Standstill rule for video
description: Sets what counts as stopped before video can play on the central display: parking brake set, transmission in Park, both, or either. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: OPP (opportunistic) transfer (SL20_OPP_TRANSFER)
description: SL-family flag enabling OPP (Object Push Profile / opportunistic Bluetooth) file transfer. Active for Japanese market (807) only.
notes: Token SL20_OPP_TRANSFER; enum only documents value 0=NICHT_AKTIV; value 1 inferred as active (standard for single-bit fields with partial enum). OPP = Bluetooth Object Push Profile.

fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / 810 Australian version / 838 Canadian version / 8AA Chinese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 3
description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the third of three such locks. Enabled at the factory for the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838 or S8AA). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Service history display
description: Shows the service history on the central display: a list of the maintenance work carried out and recorded for the car.

name: Integrated Owner's Manual
description: Turns on the Integrated Owner's Manual, the owner's handbook built into iDrive, including the context help that opens the matching page from other menus and messages.

name: Auxiliary head-unit media connection (CDMM AUX)
description: Enables an auxiliary media connection (AUX-in) routed through the CDMM (CD/Media Module). When active, an external audio source can be connected to the head unit.
notes: Token CDMM_AUX_HU; CDMM = CD/Media Module; no enum names in syset.

name: Media metadata generation
description: Setting for generating track details (metadata) in the media player.
notes: Not a user setting: Multi-byte field (bytes 3-4, whole values 0x0000 and 0x0001) with no reader: libhmicoding's table entries for both symbols (features 41/42) test byte 3 == 1, which neither value has, and HmiMain3D and the other HMI libraries never query 41/42; no other binary imports the getter. No visible effect.

name: Compass display
description: Enables a compass bearing display in the instrument cluster or head-unit status bar.
notes: Token COMPASS; self-evident token.

name: Head-unit optical drive cover enabled
description: Enables the drive slot/cover UI for the head-unit's built-in optical drive. Active by default; disabled for the 8LH China country-control variant (which lacks the drive).
notes: Token ENT_HU_DRIVE_COVER; default on; FA gate: NOT 8LH country control 04142.

fa_gate: 810 Australian version / 812 Great Britain/Ireland version / 838 Canadian version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Video only with parking brake set
description: Allows video on the central display only while the parking brake is set. Enabled at the factory for the Australian version (S810), the Great Britain and Ireland version (S812) and the Canadian version (S838). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Wind speed display (drive information)
description: Enables the wind speed readout in the head-unit drive information / efficiency display. Variant 1 = one display layout, Variant 2 = alternate layout.
notes: Token ENT_HU_DRIVE_WIND_SPEED; enum values VAR1/VAR2 map to 0/1.

name: Video lock: central display
description: Locks video playback on the central display up front. Enabled at the factory for some markets (S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Rear-seat entertainment extended options
description: 3-bit field selecting extended RSE (Rear-Seat Entertainment) option variants for special equipment configurations.
notes: Token ENT_RSE_EXT_OPTIONS; 3-bit enum; no symbolic enum values in syset for this coord.

fa_gate: 606 Navigation system Business / 609 Professional navigation system / 249 Multifunction for steering wheel / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Text-to-speech (TTS / TTS Nuance) app enable
description: SWT 'application coded' enable bit that gates whether the text-to-speech (TTS and TTS Nuance) speech synthesis component is active. Firmware-traced: queried in FUN_002f58c4 switch cases 5 (TTS) and 0xD (TTS Nuance). Requires Business nav (606) or Professional nav (609) or MFL (249).
notes: Token SWT_APP_TTS; decoded by FUN_00334984; switch cases 5 and 0xD in FUN_002f58c4.

name: CD/DVD changer installed
description: Declares that an external CD/DVD changer (6-disc, SA 696) is physically connected to the head unit. Enables changer-related UI and media source switching.
notes: Token ENT_CHANGER_INSTALLED; FA gate: 696 DVD changer for 6 DVDs; enum value 1=AKTIV.

name: CD/DVD changer cover UI
description: Enables the UI element (cover/slot graphic) for an external CD/DVD changer. allowing the changer interface to be shown even if no changer is connected.
notes: Token ENT_CHANGER_COVER; always active; no enum names in syset.

name: Personal Radio (Online Entertainment)
description: Shows Personal Radio in the media menu, a streaming radio feature of BMW Online Entertainment. Using it needs the Online Entertainment service and a data connection.

name: Multichannel audio (surround sound)
description: Enables multichannel/surround audio processing in the entertainment system.
notes: Token ENT_MULTICHANNEL; enum has NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV.

name: OE login / service-level access
description: Enables OE (Original Equipment) login or service-level coding access for authorised dealers/tools. Controls whether the service login entry point is shown in the HMI.
notes: Token OE_LOGIN_SL; OE = Original Equipment / dealer-service; no enum names in syset.

fa_gate: NOT 609 Professional navigation system / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Video playback
description: Turns on video playback in the media menu. Video while driving follows the head unit's speed-lock rules, and rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Miracast screen mirroring
description: Enables Wi-Fi Miracast wireless screen mirroring from a compatible Android device to the head-unit display.
notes: Token ENT_MIRACAST; self-evident.

name: DVD region code
description: Sets the DVD region code for the built-in optical drive. Determines which geographic region's DVDs can be played.
notes: Token ENT_VIDEO_DVD_AREA_CODE; enum values ALLE_ANDEREN (all others/region-free)=0, AREA_CODE_1-6 = DVD region codes. Default 0 = all regions.

name: Blu-ray region code
description: Sets the Blu-ray region code for the head-unit's optical drive. Determines which geographic region's Blu-ray discs can be played.

values.2: Region B (Europe, Africa, Middle East, Australia)

notes: Token ENT_VIDEO_BLUERAYD_AREA_CODE (sic: typo in token); enum: ALLE_ANDEREN=0, AREA_CODE_A/B/C = Blu-ray regions A/B/C.

name: WLAN/DLNA media server cover art
description: Enables album cover art display when streaming audio from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP = Digital Media Player).
notes: Token ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_COVERART; MC = media centre, DMP = Digital Media Player (DLNA).

name: WLAN/DLNA video streaming
description: Enables video playback from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP) on the head-unit display.
notes: Token ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_VIDEO; enum only documents value 0=NICHT_AKTIV; value 1 inferred as active.

name: Bluetooth/iPod cover art (BTAS/iAP)
description: Enables album cover art display for music played via Bluetooth Audio Streaming (BTAS) or Apple iAP (iPod Accessory Protocol).
notes: Token ENT_BTAS_IAP_COVERART; BTAS = Bluetooth Audio Streaming, IAP = iPod Accessory Protocol; always active.

name: TV electronic programme guide (EPG) presentation
description: Sets the scope/mode of the TV Electronic Programme Guide display. Standard mode vs. Advanced/extended mode.
notes: Token CDMM_TV_EPG_PRES_SCOPE; enum values STANDARD/ADVANCED; CDMM = CD/Digital Media Module.

name: Cover Flow for Professional navigation
description: Enables the Cover Flow album-art browser specifically for vehicles with Professional navigation (609). Companion to ENT_COVERFLOW, active when 609 is fitted.
notes: Token ENT_COVERFLOW_ES; default on; FA gate: 609 Professional navigation system.

name: Cover Flow vertical scroll
description: Enables vertical scrolling mode for the Cover Flow album browser (as opposed to horizontal/coverflow swipe). Active by default.
notes: Token ENT_COVERFLOW_VERTICAL; default on.

name: RSE optical drive type
description: Specifies the optical drive type fitted in the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system.
notes: Token ENT_RSE_DRIVE; 2-bit field; enum values DVD/BLU_RAY; default 1 (DVD).

name: Head-unit optical drive type
description: Specifies the type of optical drive fitted in the head unit itself.
notes: Token ENT_HU_DRIVE; 2-bit enum: CD/DVD/BLU_RAY.

name: Video HMI mode
description: Controls the HMI presentation mode for the video player: either the standard DVD-style on-screen interface or a track/title list view.
notes: Token ENT_VIDEO_HMI; enum values DVD_HMI=0, TITLE_LIST=1.

name: Online Entertainment
description: Turns on Online Entertainment, BMW's in-car music streaming service, in the media menu. Using it needs an active service and a data connection.

name: OE rear-seat entertainment features enabled
description: Enable flag for OE (dealer) rear-seat entertainment feature extensions.
notes: Token OE_RSE_ENABLED; no enum names in syset.

name: Instantaneous fuel consumption display
description: Enables the real-time (instantaneous) fuel consumption readout in the vehicle information / efficiency display on the head unit.
notes: Token MOMENTANVERBRAUCHSANZEIGE; German = 'instantaneous consumption display'; no enum names in syset.

name: Speed lock: connected app text lists
description: Sets how many lines a long text list in a connected app (one whose screens come from a phone or an online service) can show on the central display while the car is moving, for apps that don't set their own limit. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Charging power reduction (HU)
description: Enables head-unit-managed reduction of battery charging power, typically for plug-in hybrid/EV charge management.
notes: Token CHARGING_POWER_REDUCTION_HU; no enum names in syset.

name: Speech-to-text speller input level
description: Configures which speech-to-text (STT) speller input confidence levels are made available to the user. Higher = more input options; Hoch+Mittel+Gering = high+medium+low confidence inputs.
notes: Token STT_SPELLER_INPUT; enum HOCH/HOCH_MITTEL/HOCH_MITTEL_GERING (German: high/high-medium/high-medium-low).

name: AdBlue range display
description: Shows the AdBlue (diesel exhaust fluid) status in “Vehicle status” on diesel models with selective catalytic reduction (SCR) and sets the highest remaining range it shows as a number. Above that limit it shows the limit with a “>” sign. With miles as the display unit, the limits are 6,000 and 4,500 mi.

name: Automatic unlock after journey end
description: Enables automatic unlocking of the vehicle doors when the ignition is turned off and the journey ends.
notes: Token ENTRIEGELN_NACH_FAHRTENDE; German = 'unlock after journey end'; no enum names in syset.

name: Goodbye screen: hide non-transmission-capable info
description: When enabled, the goodbye/farewell screen suppresses information that cannot be transmitted (Nichtsendefaehigkeit) — i.e. content that requires connectivity not available at shutdown.
notes: Token HMI_GOODBYE_NICHTSENDEFAEHIGKEIT; German 'Nichtsendefaehigkeit' = non-transmission-capability.

name: AC fast charging
description: Enables AC fast charging capability declaration in the HMI (for plug-in hybrid/EV).
notes: Token AC_LADEN_SCHNELL; German 'Laden schnell' = fast charging; no enum names in syset.

name: Weekly departure timer
description: Enables the weekly repeating departure timer for pre-conditioning (climate/charge).
notes: Token WEEKLY_TIMER; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Climate departure timer
description: Enables the one-shot or weekly departure timer for pre-conditioning the vehicle climate before driving.
notes: Token CLIMATE_DEPARTURE; no enum names in syset.

name: DAC2 configuration
description: Configuration setting for the DAC vehicle function in the head unit's car menus. Best left unchanged.

name: NFC Bluetooth pairing speed-lock
description: When enabled, NFC-triggered Bluetooth device pairing is restricted to when the vehicle is stationary (speed-locked).
notes: Token NFC_BT_PAIRING_SPEEDLOCK; no enum names in syset.

name: NFC beam speed-lock
description: When enabled, NFC beam (data transfer via NFC tap) is restricted to when the vehicle is stationary.
notes: Token NFC_BEAM_SPEEDLOCK; enum has NICHT_AKTIV for value 0.

name: Fader front/rear balance setting
description: Enables the front/rear audio fader adjustment in the sound settings menu.
notes: Token FADER_EINSTELLUNG; German 'Einstellung' = setting; no enum names in syset.

name: Gracenote album info features
description: Chooses which Gracenote album information features the media options offer: the album information screen, which shows Gracenote details for an album, and the online lookup that updates those details from the Gracenote service. The online lookup is reached from the album information screen.

name: Media Centre active
description: Enables the Media Centre (internal hard-disk music library / ripped CD storage) feature. Requires Professional navigation (609).
notes: Token ENT_MC_ACTIV; MC = Media Centre (internal HDD music storage); FA gate: 609 Professional navigation.

fa_gate: NOT 609 Professional navigation system / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Media Centre album art cover display
description: Enables album cover art display in the Media Centre (internal HDD library) browser. Active when Professional navigation (609) is NOT fitted.
notes: Token ENT_MC_COVER; FA gate: NOT 609 Professional nav / 8LH country control.

name: Media Centre video support
description: Enables video file storage and playback from the Media Centre internal hard drive.
notes: Token ENT_MC_VIDEO_SUPPORT; enum has NICHT_AKTIV for value 0.

name: Media Centre playlist import
description: Enables importing of playlists (e.g. M3U files from USB) into the Media Centre internal library.
notes: Token ENT_MC_PLAYLIST_IMPORT; no enum names in syset.

name: Media Centre Asia character input
description: Enables Asian character set input (CJK) for Media Centre music search.
notes: Token ENT_MC_ASIA_INPUT; no enum names in syset.

name: Media Centre auto-rip (CD to HDD)
description: Enables automatic ripping of inserted audio CDs to the Media Centre internal hard drive.
notes: Token ENT_MC_AUTO_RIP_IMPORT; enum has NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV.

name: Media Centre auto backup/restore
description: Enables automatic backup and restore of the Media Centre (HDD music library) to/from an external source.
notes: Token ENT_MC_AUTO_BACKUPRESTORE; no enum names in syset.

name: Media Centre WLAN/DLNA streaming
description: Enables streaming audio from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP) directly into the Media Centre.
notes: Token ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP; MC = Media Centre, DMP = DLNA media server.

name: Web server for online services
description: Turns on the head unit's built-in web server, which BMW's online services use to show their content on the central display. Enabled at the factory with BMW Live (S6AL) or TeleServices (S6AE).

name: Media Centre: allow deleting music search index
description: Enables the user option to delete the music search/metadata index in the Media Centre.
notes: Token ENT_MC_DELETE_MUSICSEARCH; no enum names in syset.

name: Media Centre song bookmarks
description: Enables the ability to bookmark individual songs/tracks in the Media Centre library.
notes: Token ENT_MC_SONG_BOOKMARKS; no enum names in syset.

name: Media Centre time-shift recording
description: Enables time-shift recording (pause/rewind live media) in the Media Centre.
notes: Token ENT_MC_TIMESHIFT_REC; no enum names in syset.

name: Music collection: driver profile link
description: Setting that links the music collection with the driver profiles, the personal settings the head unit keeps for each key. Best left unchanged.

name: Media Centre album art scale/fit
description: Enables scaled/fitted display of album cover art in the Media Centre (filling the display rather than displaying at native size).
notes: Token ENT_MC_COVER_SCALE; no enum names in syset.

name: Gracenote database installed
description: Declares that the Gracenote music recognition database is installed on the head unit (on internal storage).
notes: Token ENT_GRACENOTE_INSTALLED; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Gesture control
description: Turns on gesture control for cars with the gesture camera: hand movements in front of the central display can change the volume, accept or reject calls and more.

name: X-View 3D camera view
description: Enables the X-View (360-degree / 3D surround camera view) feature on the head-unit display.
notes: Token X_VIEW; no enum names in syset.

name: Gracenote database via USB
description: Enables loading/updating the Gracenote music database from a USB drive.
notes: Token ENT_GRACENOTE_USB; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Gracenote music lookup (MLT / over-the-air)
description: Enables Gracenote MLT (Music Label Tagging / online music recognition lookup) for identifying and tagging music.
notes: Token ENT_GRACENOTE_MLT; enum has NICHT_AKTIV for value 0.

name: Gracenote music service
description: Enables the Gracenote music metadata service (artist/album/track tag lookup) in the entertainment system.
notes: Token ENT_GRACENOTE_SERVICE; no enum names in syset.

name: Ogg audio playback
description: Lets the head unit play Ogg audio files, such as Ogg Vorbis music, from connected media.

name: Xvid video playback
description: Lets the head unit play video files encoded with Xvid, a common MPEG-4 video format.

name: Video CD playback
description: Lets the head unit play Video CDs (VCD), an older disc format for movies and music videos.

name: MLS/MI language switching mode
description: Enables or configures the MLS (Multi-Language Support) / MI (Market Interface) language and interface mode switch.
notes: Token SWITCH_MLS_MI; always active (default 1); no enum names in syset. MLS = Multi-Language Support, MI = Market Interface.

name: Navigation in cluster: AR presentation
description: Setting for how the navigation map is presented in the instrument cluster (AR presentation). Best left unchanged.

name: Satellite radio module generation (SDARS)
description: Specifies the generation of the SDARS (Satellite Digital Audio Radio Service, e.g. SiriusXM) module.
notes: Token SDARS_MODUL; enum GEN_4_5=0, X65=1; default field value = 1 (X65 module).

name: HDMI/MHL AUX video input
description: Enables an HDMI or MHL (Mobile High-Definition Link) auxiliary video input port connection to the head unit.
notes: Token HDMI_MHL_AUX_IN; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Distance unit setting in vehicle info
description: Enables the distance unit (km/miles) selector in the vehicle information / settings display.
notes: Token SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DISTANCE; no enum names in syset.

name: High-capacity oil quantity (3L) display
description: Enables display logic for vehicles with a high-capacity engine oil reservoir (e.g. 3-litre / large engine oil quantities).
notes: Token OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH; no enum names in syset.

name: Date display in vehicle info
description: Enables the current date readout in the vehicle information / settings display.
notes: Token SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DATE; enum has NICHT_AKTIV for value 0.

name: NFC status display
description: Enables display of the NFC (Near-Field Communication) module status in the settings/connectivity menu.
notes: Token NFC_STATUS; no enum names in syset.

fa_gate: 601 TV Function / 606 Navigation system Business / 609 Professional navigation system
name: iDrive controller (ZBE) new hard-key layout
description: Enables the newer iDrive controller (ZBE) hard-key button layout. Required when a newer ZBE controller with a revised button arrangement is fitted (e.g. with touch surface or revised media buttons). Active when TV function (601), Business nav (606), or Professional nav (609) is fitted.
notes: Token ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_NEW; ZBE = Zentralbedieneinheit (iDrive controller); FA gate: 601/606/609.

name: Steering wheel buttons: MINI skip variant
description: Enables the MINI-variant skip/seek button mapping for the MFL (Multi-Function steering wheel / Lenkrad) buttons. not MINI).
notes: Token MFL_SKIP_MINI; MFL = Multifunktions-Lenkrad (multi-function steering wheel).

name: Speaker lighting
description: Shows the setting for the illuminated speaker covers installed with some high-end sound systems, such as Bang & Olufsen.

name: Navigation: EV import
description: Setting for the navigation system's electric-vehicle data, used in its energy consumption calculations. Best left unchanged.

name: Front armrest control panel
description: Enables the front centre armrest control panel (touch/button controls in the armrest).
notes: Token ARMREST_FRONT_CONTROL; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Entertainment list index mode
description: Selects how the entertainment list browser indexes and displays entries: no index, read-only mode, or read/write mode.
notes: Token ENT_INDEX_LIST; 2-bit enum: NONE/READING_DATA/WRITING_DATA.

name: Light carpet
description: Shows the light carpet setting in the exterior lighting menu. The light carpet lights up the ground beside the doors when you unlock the car or open a door.

name: Door handle lighting
description: Offers the door handle lighting setting in the exterior lighting menu, for cars with illuminated door handles.

name: Ambient light colour switch ensemble
description: Selects the variant of the ambient light colour-switch button/ensemble in the interior. Controls whether the ambient lighting colour controls are in the default layout, colour switch, or colour switch with panoramic roof.
notes: Token BENENNUNG_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE; 2-bit enum: DEFAULT/FARBE/FARBE_PANORAMADACH (German: colour/colour+panoramic roof); BENENNUNG = designation/label.

name: Ambient light deactivation: follow interior lighting
description: Controls whether the ambient lighting (Ambilight) deactivation option is in default mode or coupled to the interior lighting. When set to Interior lighting (1), the ambilight turns off and on together with the interior room lighting.

values.0: Default (ambient light behavior not coupled to interior lighting)
values.1: Interior lighting (ambient light follows interior lighting on/off)

notes: Token BENENNUNG_DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMBILIGHT; enum DEFAULT=0, INNENRAUMBELEUCHTUNG=1. INNENRAUMBELEUCHTUNG = interior lighting — value 1 couples ambilight to interior lights, not independent.

name: Captain's chair seating
description: Declares that the vehicle has captain's chair rear seating (individual rear bucket seats rather than a bench). Adjusts applicable HMI seat control menus.
notes: Token CAPTAINCHAIR; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Seat multi-function controls
description: Enables the seat multi-function control menu (e.g. massage, memory, ventilation combined control).
notes: Token SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION; no enum names in syset.

name: Comfort exit seat adjustment
description: Enables the comfort exit feature — when a door is opened, the seat slides back to ease exit. Shows a checkbox in the HMI settings.
notes: Token HMI_CHECKBOX_COMFORT_EXIT; no enum names in syset.

name: Seat auto-climate
description: Enables automatic seat climate control (heated/ventilated seat that adjusts automatically based on cabin conditions).
notes: Token SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Rear seat ventilation
description: Enables rear seat ventilation control in the HMI.
notes: Token SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Fragrance ioniser
description: Enables the interior fragrance/ioniser system control in the HMI (e.g. BMW ambient air fragrance diffuser).
notes: Token DUFT_IONISATOR; German 'Duft' = fragrance, 'Ionisator' = ioniser; no enum names in syset.

name: Automatic time synchronisation source
description: Selects whether the head-unit clock is synchronised automatically, and from which source (offline/not active, online ConnectedDrive, or GPS navigation).
notes: Token SETTINGS_TIME_AUTOMATIC; 2-bit enum: NICHT_AKTIV/ONLINE/NAVIGATION.

name: Automatic window close in rain
description: Enables the feature that automatically closes windows/convertible roof when rain is detected.
notes: Token REGEN_SCHLIESSEN; German 'Regen' = rain, 'Schliessen' = close; no enum names in syset.

name: Always open HMI (bypass speed-lock)
description: Forces the HMI to remain open/accessible at all times regardless of speed-lock rules.
notes: Token ALWAYS_OPEN_HMI; no enum names in syset.

name: MINI colour switch setting
description: Enables the MINI-variant interior colour selector setting in the HMI. not MINI).
notes: Token SETTINGS_COLOUR_SWITCH_MINI; no enum names in syset.

name: Smartphone apps: XL layout
description: Tells connected smartphone apps that they can use the XL (large-format) layout, so supported apps fill more of the central display.

fa_gate: NOT 606 Navigation system Business / 609 Professional navigation system / 6NR Apps / 6VB Infotainment control / 6AE TeleServices
name: Smartphone apps: map content
description: Tells connected smartphone apps that the head unit can show their map content, so supported apps can offer maps on the central display. Takes effect only when “Central display type” (`3001/57/11111111b`) is the wide display or the display with cover flap.

name: Smartphone apps: profiles (PIA)
description: Tells connected smartphone apps whether the head unit offers PIA, its personal profile feature, so supported apps can use it. Enabled at the factory with Apps (S6NR) or TeleServices (S6AE). Best left unchanged.

name: Maximum navigation range display
description: 4-bit numeric field selecting the maximum displayed range value in the EV / hybrid range indicator. encoded as a step index, not a direct km value.
notes: Token RANGE_MAX; 4-bit numeric, no symbolic enum names; raw codes 0-7 correspond to range steps (e.g. 3=1200km per cur_desc).

name: USB ports installed
description: Tells the head unit which USB ports the car has and whether a snap-in adapter (phone cradle) is connected, so the matching media sources appear. Check only what the car has.

name: HMI generation version
description: Selects the iDrive HMI generation: ID4++ (iDrive 4 enhanced, older NBT Evo interface) or ID5 (iDrive 5 style, newer interface with tile/widget home screen).
notes: Token HMI_VERSION; enum ID4_PLUS_PLUS=0, ID5=1.

name: Japanese music search reading (kana/romaji)
description: Enables the Japanese phonetic reading (kana or romaji) input mode for music search in the entertainment system. Active for Japanese market (807).
notes: Token ENT_JAPAN_SEARCH_READING; FA gate: 807 Japanese version; no enum names in syset.

name: Japanese speller input variant
description: Selects the Japanese speller keyboard variant (with or without phonetic mapping for kana input). Active for Japanese market (807).
notes: Token ENT_JAPAN_SPELLER_VARIANT; enum SPELLER_OHNE_MAPPING=0, SPELLER_MIT_MAPPING=1; FA gate: 807 Japanese version.

name: Taiwan music search reading (zhuyin/pinyin)
description: Enables the Taiwan phonetic reading input mode for music search. Active for Taiwan country-control (8LT) variant.
notes: Token ENT_TAIWAN_SEARCH_READING; FA gate: 8LT Country control 04825; no enum names in syset.

name: Taiwan speller input variant
description: Selects the Taiwan speller keyboard variant (with or without phonetic mapping for zhuyin/bopomofo input). Active for Taiwan country-control (8LT) variant.
notes: Token ENT_TAIWAN_SPELLER_VARIANT; enum SPELLER_OHNE_MAPPING=0, SPELLER_MIT_MAPPING=1; FA gate: 8LT Country control.

name: Bowers & Wilkins high-end audio system menu
description: Selects the B&W (Bowers & Wilkins) high-end audio system's light staging / 'Surround Sound Experience' presentation mode shown in the HMI. Controls whether a menu is shown and what level of ambient light staging accompanies the audio.
notes: Token HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W; enum KEIN_MENUE/KEINE_INSZ/NUR_LICHTINSZ/VOLLE_INSZ (no menu/no staging/light-only staging/full staging).

name: John Cooper Works HMI theme
description: Enables the John Cooper Works (JCW) branded HMI theme/graphics for MINI JCW models. not MINI JCW).
notes: Token JOHN_COOPER_WORKS_HMI; self-evident.

name: eDrive popup suppression
description: Suppresses the eDrive mode popup/notification that appears when switching electric drive modes (for plug-in hybrid/EV).
notes: Token EDRIVE_POPUP_DEACTIVATE; no enum names in syset.

name: eDrive mode toggle available
description: Enables the eDrive (electric drive) mode toggle button/option in the driving experience controls.
notes: Token EDRIVE_TOGGLE_AVAILABLE; no enum names in syset.

name: iDrive usage statistics
description: Records statistics on how the iDrive menus and controls are used.
notes: Not a user setting: Usage statistics only: HmiMain3D's AbkStatistic manager (CHmiAbkStatisticManager/Counter/Timer/FileIO) counts key, speech, gesture and menu events into a statistics file; no screen in the HMI shows them. No driver-visible effect.

name: Logic 7 audio system branding icon
description: Shows the Logic 7 surround-sound system branding symbol/icon in the audio settings menu.
notes: Token LOGIC7_SYMBOL; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: ConnectedDrive services
description: Enables the BMW ConnectedDrive online services menu and framework.
notes: Token CONNECTED_DRIVE; self-evident; no enum names in syset.

name: Hybrid vehicle mode
description: Declares the vehicle as a hybrid (plug-in or full hybrid), enabling hybrid-specific HMI elements such as eDrive displays and charge indicators.
notes: Token HYBRID; self-evident; enum has only AKTIV for value 1.

name: Headlight settings menu
description: Shows the headlight settings in the exterior lighting menu, such as daytime running lights and the setting for driving on the other side of the road.

name: Apple enhancements (BMW Apps / CarPlay prep)
description: Enables Apple-specific enhancements in the HMI, primarily the BMW Apps (A4A/PIA) Apple integration layer. Required together with 6NR Apps SA for Siri/Apple app features. Active when 6NR Apps is fitted.
notes: Token APPLE_ENHANCEMENTS; FA gate: 6NR Apps; no enum names in syset.

name: Speech feedback audio channel
description: Enables a dedicated audio feedback channel for speech recognition (voice commands are acknowledged via a separate audio path rather than interrupting the main audio). Active when 6NR Apps is fitted.
notes: Token SPEECH_FEEDBACK_CHANNEL; enum NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV; FA gate: 6NR Apps.

name: Tourist light change with engine on
description: Lets you change the headlight setting for driving on the other side of the road (tourist function) while the engine is running. When disabled, it can be changed only with the engine off.

name: Service history: who can access/edit
description: Controls who has access to view or modify the service history records. Default = dealer/BMW access; value 1 = owner/driver access also allowed.
notes: Token SERVICE_HISTORY_WHO; enum DEFAULT=0, WERT_1=1.

name: WCA (wireless charging area) display
description: Enables the WCA (Wireless Charging Area) status and settings in the HMI connectivity menu.
notes: Token WCA; WCA = Wireless Charging Area (Qi inductive charging pad); no enum names in syset.

name: Armrest all-zone control
description: Enables HMI control of an electric armrest covering all zones. When active, an armrest adjustment menu is shown.

name: RSE media serving mode
description: Configures what the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system can do when browsing media: basic playback only, skipping tracks, or full library browsing.
notes: RSE=Rear Seat Entertainment. German token RSE_SERVING_SETTINGS. Value 0 absent from firmware enum (field uses 1-3).

fa_gate: NOT 544 Cruise control with braking function / 710 M leather steering wheel / 249 Multifunction for steering wheel
name: Speed-dependent volume (SLD) available
description: Enables speed-dependent volume (Geschwindigkeitsabhaengige Lautstaerkeanpassung / SLD) function in the audio settings.
notes: SLD = Geschwindigkeitsabhaengige Lautstaerkeregelung (speed-dependent loudness). No symbolic enum in firmware; single-bit field.

fa_gate: NOT 322 Comfort Access / 812 Great Britain/Ireland version
name: Doors/Key menu: tailgate options
description: Shows the tailgate options in the “Doors/Key” menu, which set how the tailgate unlocks with the remote key.

name: Doors/Key menu: Comfort Access
description: Shows the Comfort Access options in the “Doors/Key” settings, for cars that unlock and lock when you touch the door handle with the key nearby.

name: Doors/Key menu: Comfort Access tailgate
description: Shows the tailgate options that belong to Comfort Access in the “Doors/Key” menu, for cars whose tailgate can be opened with the key nearby.

name: Doors/Key menu: comfort cooling
description: Shows a cooling option among the Comfort Access settings in the “Doors/Key” menu.

name: Doors/Key menu: second rear opening
description: Shows the options for a second, smaller rear opening, such as a rear window that opens on its own, in the “Doors/Key” menu.

name: Special vehicle type
description: Identifies special/authority vehicle designation. Used for vehicles fitted with special authority markings.
notes: Firmware enum values: 1=SECURITY, 2=AUTHORITY_MARKED, 3=AUTHORITY_UNMARKED. Value 0 (standard/not special) has no symbolic name in the firmware descriptor and has been removed from the values map.

name: Doors/Key menu: tailgate name
description: Chooses what the “Doors/Key” menu calls the car's rear opening: rear window, tailgate, front gate or split doors. Match it to the car's body style.

name: Off-road gauge (Offroadmeter)
description: Enables the off-road gauges/display in the instrument cluster or HMI for off-road capable vehicles.
notes: German: OFFROADMETER. Firmware enum only names value 2 (TEIL_AKTIV = partially active); values 0, 1, 3 carry no symbolic name.

name: Car wash button
description: Shows a car wash button in the parking and camera menu, which switches the camera system into its car wash mode.

fa_gate: 8AA Chinese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 71 type tokens, e.g. 1A10,1A11,1A12,1A31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 65 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11DE,12CK,12DE) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 55 type tokens, e.g. 11CL,12CL,1K51,1K52) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Air quality popup notification
description: Enables a popup notification for the air quality sensor reading. Active on Chinese-market variants (8AA) and certain vehicle body-type groups.
notes: German: AIRQUALITY_POPUP. Gated on 8AA (Chinese version) or several vehicle type groups. not Chinese market spec.

name: Doors/Key menu: second opening name
description: Chooses what the “Doors/Key” menu calls the second, smaller rear opening: rear window, tailgate or front gate.

name: Doors/Key menu: unlock options
description: Shows the unlock options in the “Doors/Key” menu, where you choose whether the remote key first unlocks only the driver's door or all doors.

name: Doors/Key menu: home lights
description: Shows a home lights option among the Comfort Access settings in the “Doors/Key” menu.

name: 3D view graphic slope interpolation
description: Sets the interpolation curve for the slope (pitch) axis in the 3D vehicle graphic (X-View). LINEAR=direct proportional, TRAJECTORY variants use non-linear curves.
notes: German: X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_SLOP. X-View is the 3D exterior vehicle graphic. Firmware enum: LINEAR/TRAJECTORY1/TRAJECTORY2/TRAJECTORY3.

name: 3D view graphic roll interpolation
description: Sets the interpolation curve for the roll axis in the 3D vehicle graphic (X-View).
notes: German: X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_ROLL. Firmware enum: LINEAR/TRAJECTORY1/TRAJECTORY2/TRAJECTORY3.

name: Front seat ventilation
description: Enables front seat ventilation control in the HMI settings menu.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV.

name: Rear seat heating
description: Enables rear seat heating control in the HMI.

name: Front seat heating
description: Enables front seat heating control in the HMI.

name: Seat training / posture program
description: Enables an automatic seat position training/exercise program that periodically adjusts the seat for ergonomics.
notes: German: SEAT_TRAINING. No symbolic enum; single-bit field.

name: Front seat lumbar support
description: Enables lumbar support (Lordose) adjustment in the front seat settings menu.
notes: German: SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE. Lordose = lumbar curve adjustment.

name: Front seat massage
description: Enables the front seat massage function in the HMI.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV.

name: Rear seat massage
description: Enables the rear seat massage function in the HMI.

name: Rear seat multifunction controls
description: Enables the rear seat multifunction control panel (e.g. recliner, legrest, individual climate) in the HMI.
notes: German: SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION.

name: Deactivatable seat-belt alert (SBA)
description: Allows the seat-belt reminder alert (SBA) to be turned off by the driver in settings.
notes: German: DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_SBA. DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT = deactivatability. SBA = Sitzgurt-Bremsassistent (seatbelt/brake warning system).

name: Deactivatable parking brake alert (PBA)
description: Allows the parking brake alert (PBA) to be deactivated by the user through settings.
notes: German: DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_PBA. PBA = Parkbremsassistent alert.

name: Automatic climate recirculation (AUC)
description: Specifies whether automatic air recirculation (AUC = Automatische Umluftsteuerung) is fitted, which closes the fresh air intake when poor outside air quality is detected.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=AUC_NICHT_VORHANDEN, 1=AUC_VORHANDEN. AUC = Automatische Umluftsteuerung.

name: Indirect ventilation (diffuse air mode)
description: Indicates whether indirect/diffuse ventilation (deflecting air from vents) is available in the climate system.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=INDIREKTE_BELUEFTUNG_NICHT_VERFUEGBAR, 1=INDIREKTE_BELUEFTUNG_VERFUEGBAR. INDIREKTE_BELUEFTUNG = diffuse/indirect ventilation.

name: HVAC steering/operation mode (STRA menu)
description: Sets how the HVAC system is operated in the iDrive HMI: display-only (sense/touch or rotary), full MMI control, or MMI control in 1-zone mode.
notes: Firmware enum: 1=NUR_VISUALISIERUNG_SENSE_TOUCH, 2=NUR_VISUALISIERUNG_RAENDEL, 3=BEDIENUNG_VIA_MMI, 4=BEDIENUNG_VIA_MMI_1Z. STRA=Steuerung (control); RAENDEL=rotary wheel; 1Z=1-zone.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 71 type tokens, e.g. 1A10,1A11,1A12,1A31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 61 type tokens, e.g. 1D11,1D12,1D31,1D32)
name: LCI (facelift) variant
description: Flags this vehicle as an LCI (Life Cycle Impulse / facelift) model. Enables LCI-specific menus and display elements.
notes: LCI = Life Cycle Impulse (BMW facelift designation). Gated on specific body codes.

name: Gesture control: two-finger gesture
description: Turns on the two-finger gesture, whose action you choose in the gesture settings (such as opening the main menu or muting audio), in the standard version or the version for China.

name: HMI ID version / iDrive generation
description: Selects the iDrive HMI interface generation/version loaded for this vehicle. Determines the overall HMI look and feature set.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=ID4_PLUS_PLUS, 1=ID5, 2=ID5_PLUS_PLUS, 3=ID6_LIGHT, 4=ID6.

name: Tire settings in tire pressure menu
description: Adds a tire settings screen to the tire pressure menu, where you select the tires installed and how heavily the car is loaded, so the monitor checks against the right pressures. The extended version adds tire identification.

name: Speed lock: car standstill condition
description: Defines what vehicle condition is required to unlock speed-restricted functions (handbrake, gearbox in P, or a combination).
notes: Firmware enum: NONE/HANDBRAKE/GEARBOX_P/HANDBRAKE_AND_GEARBOX_P/HANDBRAKE_OR_GEARBOX_P.

name: Miracast display in settings
description: Shows the Miracast wireless display option in the entertainment settings menu.
notes: ENT_MIRACAST_DISPLAY_SETTINGS. No symbolic enum; single-bit field.

name: USB display in settings
description: Shows the USB display/mirroring option in the entertainment settings menu.
notes: ENT_USB_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.

name: HDMI display in settings
description: Shows the HDMI input option in the entertainment settings menu.
notes: ENT_HDMI_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.

name: Remote 360-degree camera
description: Enables remote/external 360-degree surround-view camera functionality.
notes: REMOTE360.

fa_gate: 249 Multifunction for steering wheel / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Multifunction steering wheel (MFL)
description: Enables HMI integration of multifunction steering wheel (MFL = Multifunktionslenkrad) buttons.
notes: MFL = Multifunktionslenkrad. Active when FA option 249 is present.

name: Speed lock: speller/keyboard input restriction
description: Controls how text/address input via the speller or touchpad is locked while the vehicle is moving.
notes: Firmware enum: NONE_LOCKED/TOUCHCID_LOCKED/TOUCHCID_AND_PAD_LOCKED/ALL_LOCKED.

fa_gate: 838 Canadian version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Speed lock: destination text display length
description: Sets how much of a destination/address text string is shown while the vehicle is in motion.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=WHOLE_TEXT, 1=ONE_PAGE, 3=NO_TEXT. Value 2 has no symbolic name in firmware.

name: Speed lock: video playback restriction
description: Enables restriction of video (moving picture) playback while driving.
notes: SPEEDLOCK_MOVING_PICTURES. No symbolic enum; single-bit field.

name: Speed lock: additional picture display restriction
description: Restricts access to picture/image viewing while the vehicle is moving.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV.

name: Speed lock: interactive map (additional) restriction
description: Restricts use of additional interactive map features while driving.
notes: SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_ADD.

name: Speed lock: interactive map (main) restriction
description: Restricts main interactive map use while the vehicle is in motion.
notes: SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_MAIN.

fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / 810 Australian version / 838 Canadian version / 8AA Chinese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93) / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Speed lock: owner's manual from Check Control
description: Blocks opening the Integrated Owner's Manual from a Check Control message while the car is moving. Enabled at the factory for some markets, such as the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838, S8AA or S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / 810 Australian version / 838 Canadian version / 8AA Chinese version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93) / 8LH Country control 04142
name: Speed lock: owner's manual short form
description: Blocks the short form of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving. Enabled at the factory for some markets, such as the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838, S8AA or S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Speed lock: owner's manual index
description: Blocks the index of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Automatic seat climate: front
description: Chooses which seat climate functions the head unit offers in automatic mode for the front seats. A checked item is offered; check only what the front seats have.

name: Automatic seat climate: rear
description: Chooses which seat climate functions the head unit offers in automatic mode for the rear seats. A checked item is offered; check only what the rear seats have.

name: Active automatic steering wheel heating
description: Enables automatic steering wheel heating control via the HMI.
notes: German: AKT_AUTO_LENKRADHEIZUNG. LENKRAD=steering wheel, HEIZUNG=heating.

name: Gesture control on by default
description: Sets whether gesture control starts out switched on or off, for example on a new car or after the gesture settings are reset.

name: Setup wizard on first boot
description: Enables an initial setup wizard that runs the first time the vehicle is started or after a factory reset, guiding the driver through key settings.
notes: SETUP_WIZARD.

name: M model on 35up platform
description: Tells the head unit the car is a BMW M model built on the 35up vehicle architecture, so it offers the M-specific menus for those cars. Enable it only on such a car.

name: M-specific menu
description: Enables the M-specific settings and drive menu in the iDrive HMI (M Drive / M Setup menus).
notes: German: M_MENUE.

name: M xDrive settings
description: Shows the M xDrive settings on M models with M xDrive, where the driver picks the all-wheel-drive mode, such as 4WD or 4WD Sport.

name: M launch/staging animation (Inszenierung)
description: Enables the M-specific startup/launch staging animation or choreography in the HMI.
notes: German: M_INSZENIERUNG. INSZENIERUNG=staging/choreography (e.g. startup light show).

name: M shift lights
description: Enables the M shift lights feature (RPM-based shift indicator lights) shown in the instrument cluster or HMI.
notes: M_SHIFTLIGHTS.

name: Battery charge control available
description: Indicates whether the user-adjustable battery charge control (setting the target state-of-charge) is available on this vehicle.
notes: BATTERY_CONTROL_AVAILABILITY. Relevant for plug-in hybrids / EV models.

name: Battery charge target: step size
description: Sets the increment step size (in percent) for the user-selectable battery charge target SOC (state of charge).
notes: BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_STEP. Default=01. No symbolic enum names; raw numeric step value.

name: Battery charge target: maximum SOC
description: Sets the maximum selectable target state of charge (SOC) percentage for battery charge control.
notes: BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MAX. No symbolic enum names; raw numeric value (e.g. coded value 2 observed). Numeric field only.

name: Battery charge target: minimum SOC
description: Sets the minimum selectable target state of charge (SOC) percentage for battery charge control.
notes: BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MIN. No symbolic enum names; raw numeric value. Numeric field only.

name: 5-flash one-touch lane-change indicator
description: Enables the convenience 5-flash turn signal function: a single tap of the indicator stalk produces 5 flashes for lane changes.
notes: Firmware token: 5_FACH_TIPPBLINKEN (recovered from sysetshellevo Table-A descriptor @file 0x07d9fc, name vaddr 0x1e1e6c). 5-FACH=5-fold, TIPPBLINKEN=one-touch flash indicator.

name: Miracast: multiple simultaneous streams
description: Enables support for multiple simultaneous Miracast wireless display streams (e.g. front and rear screens independently).
notes: ENT_MIRACAST_MULTIPLE_STREAMS.

name: Charging preferences: ESL
description: Setting used by the charging preferences of plug-in hybrid and electric models. Best left unchanged.

fa_gate: NOT 8LH Country control 04142 / 6NS Comfort telephony with expanded smartphone connection / 6NW Telephony with wireless charging
name: Office (connected apps) menus active
description: Enables the BMW Connected Drive 'Office' menu group (messages, calendar, tasks, notes) in the iDrive HMI.
notes: OFFICE_MENUS_ACTIVE. Suppressed when 6NW (wireless charging phone) or 6NS (comfort telephony) is fitted, or on 8LH markets.

name: Battery charge control: configurable home/residential mode
description: Enables a user-configurable home/residential charging energy mode (Wohnen = home usage scenario). Firmware enum only names value 0 as NICHT_AKTIV (not active).
notes: German: BATTERY_CONTROL_CONFIGURABLE_WOHNEN. WOHNEN=home/living (residential energy usage mode). Firmware enum only has value 0=NICHT_AKTIV; no active-state name defined.

name: High oil capacity (3+ litre sump)
description: Flags that the engine has a large oil sump capacity (>=3 litres above standard), affecting oil condition display intervals.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV. OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH_3L. Relevant for V8/V12 engines with larger sumps.

name: NFC hotspot pairing
description: Enables NFC tap-to-pair for the vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot, allowing a phone to join the hotspot by touching an NFC sensor.
notes: NFC_HOTSPOT_PAIRING.

name: Automatic exterior mirror folding setting
description: Shows the automatic exterior mirror folding option in the vehicle settings menu.
notes: Firmware enum only has value 1=AKTIV. SETTINGS_AUTOMATIC_EXT_MIRROR_FOLDING.

name: Ambient fragrance: climate menu button type
description: Configures whether and which type of button is shown in the climate menu for the ambient fragrance (Beduefter) system.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=OHNE_TASTE, 1=TASTE_BEDUFTER, 2=TASTE_KLIMAMENUE. TASTE=button, BEDUFTER=fragrance dispenser, KLIMAMENUE=climate menu.

name: Fragrance cartridge holder orientation
description: Sets the physical orientation of the fragrance cartridge holder in the vehicle (vertical or horizontal install).
notes: Firmware enum: 1=VERTICAL, 2=HORIZONTAL. ORIENTATION_FRAGRANCE_CARTRIDGE_HOLDER.

name: AdBlue filler position
description: Specifies where the AdBlue (diesel exhaust fluid) filler cap is located on the vehicle.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=NEXT_TO_FUEL_TANK, 1=IN_ENGINE_COMPARTMENT. POSITION_ADBLUE_TANK. Relevant for diesel SCR vehicles.

name: Indirect ventilation: 2-zone climate
description: Enables indirect ventilation control for a 2-zone (driver + passenger) climate system.
notes: CLIMATE_INDIRECTVENTILATION_2ZONES.

name: Gesture control: voice dialogs
description: Lets gesture control act on voice control dialogs, for example a swipe gesture while a voice dialog is open. Works only when “Gesture control” (`3000/14/10000000b`) is enabled.

name: Wireless charging pad position
description: Specifies the physical location of the wireless charging area (WCA = Wireless Charging Area) in the vehicle.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=CENTER_STACK, 1=CENTER_CONSOLE. WCA_POSITION.

name: Bluetooth audio cover art browsing
description: Enables album cover art display and browsing when using Bluetooth audio (BT Audio Source / BTAS).
notes: Firmware enum only has value 1=AKTIV. ENT_BTAS_BROWSING_COVER. BTAS = Bluetooth Audio Source.

name: eDrive startup mode
description: Shows a setting that lets the driver choose which eDrive mode a plug-in hybrid starts in.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Speed lock: see all (unrestricted view)
description: When active, allows all menu items to be visible while driving (not hidden by speed lock), though interaction may still be restricted.
notes: SPEEDLOCK_SEE_ALL. Active on certain market/type groups.

name: External HU drive (entertainment)
description: Enables an external storage drive connected directly to the head unit for entertainment (media storage/playback).
notes: ENT_HU_EXT_DRIVE.

name: M xDrive 2WD mode
description: Enables the 2WD (rear-wheel drive only) mode selector for M vehicles with xDrive.
notes: M_ALLRAD_2WD. Available on M5/M8 Competition with xDrive for track use.

name: PMA cursor orientation (longitudinal/lateral)
description: Sets the axis orientation of the Park Distance Control (PMA = Parkmanoeuvrerassistent) cursor on the HMI display.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=LAENGS (longitudinal), 1=QUER (lateral/transverse). CURSORPOSITION_PMA_AUSRICHTUNG. AUSRICHTUNG=orientation.

name: Key memory: vehicle level change
description: Enables or disables the vehicle suspension level change option in the key memory configuration.
notes: Firmware enum: 0=DISABLE, 1=ENABLE. KEY_CONF_LEVEL_CHANGE_VEHICLE. Relevant for air suspension vehicles.

name: External HU drive type (entertainment)
description: Specifies what kind of external drive is available for entertainment content connected to the head unit.
notes: Firmware enum: 1=CDDA, 2=CDDA_DATADISC. ENT_DRIVE_HU_EXT_AVAILABLE. CDDA = audio CD format.

name: Soccer Mum / easy-access seat
description: Enables the 'Soccer Mum' easy-entry/exit seat feature for the rear seats, simplifying rear passenger egress (seat slides back).
notes: SEAT_SOCCER_MUM.

name: Bus network generation (ALEV4)
description: Identifies the vehicle bus architecture generation. Determines whether this is an NBT Evo BN2015 or BN2018 network generation.

notes: Token SETTINGS_SPIRITOFECSTASY; the Spirit of Ecstasy is the Rolls-Royce bonnet mascot.

name: ZBE Touch interactive map
description: Enables touch-based interactive map control via the ZBE (iDrive controller) touchpad, allowing the user to pan and zoom the navigation map by swiping on the iDrive dial surface.
notes: Token ZBE_TOUCH_INTERACTIVE_MAP; ZBE=Zentralbedienelement (iDrive controller); active with Professional Navigation (609).

name: ZBE Touch speller input
description: Enables the touchpad gesture speller on the ZBE iDrive controller, allowing the user to draw letters on the dial surface for text entry.
notes: Token ZBE_TOUCH_SPELLER; active with Professional Navigation (609).

name: ZBE Touch browser swipe
description: Enables touch-based list browsing via the ZBE iDrive controller touchpad, allowing the user to swipe through menus and lists by sliding a finger on the dial.
notes: Token ZBE_TOUCH_BROWSER; active with Professional Navigation (609).

name: Interior light bar
description: Shows the setting for the interior light bar (Lichtschwert, light sword) in the interior lighting menu, for cars with one installed.

name: Reserved (byte 107 bits 1,0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Firmware acknowledges this bit position (bare magic word in sysetshellevo) but ships no name. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_107_bits1,0; bare magic 0x43835818 in sysetshellevo.

name: Individual ambient lighting colour
description: Enables the individual colour selection for interior ambient lighting, allowing the driver to choose from a custom colour palette rather than a preset colour set.
notes: Token INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT; Ambientelicht=ambient light.

name: Ambient lighting permanent display (FES)
description: Enables a permanent-on ambient lighting display mode for FES (Fahrerlebnisschalter / driving experience switch) variants, keeping the ambient light visible at all times regardless of other settings.
notes: Token AMBIENTELICHT_PERMANENTANZEIGE_FES; Permanentanzeige=permanent display, FES=Fahrerlebnisschalter (driving experience switch).

name: Remote HMI access level
description: Sets the access level for Remote HMI (remote head-unit display/control, e.g. BMW Connected app mirroring or ConnectedDrive remote services).
notes: Token REMOTE_HMI; 3-bit field; firmware names only value 2=RESTRICTED. Other values undefined in firmware.

name: A4A (Apps for Auto) enabled
description: Master enable bit for the Apps for Auto (A4A) smartphone integration framework. When active, the HMI exposes the A4A app infrastructure for connected smartphone apps.
notes: Token A4A; See also SWT_APP_A4A (byte 110 bit7) for the SWT-gated companion bit.

name: A4A remote apps enabled
description: Enables remote app execution within the A4A framework, allowing approved smartphone apps to run on or through the head unit via the connected phone.
notes: Token A4A_REMOTE_APPS.

name: Terminal UI
description: Enables the Terminal UI feature, a screen-mirroring / remote-display interface allowing an external device to render its UI on the iDrive screen.
notes: Token TERMINAL_UI.

name: Ambient lighting deactivation option (brand)
description: Selects the brand-specific option for whether ambient lighting can be deactivated by the user, and which brand's implementation to use (BMW or MINI style).
notes: Token DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMBILIGHT; Deaktivierungsmöglichkeit=deactivation option; value_map: 1=DEAKTIVIERUNG_BMW, 2=DEAKTIVIERUNG_MINI.

name: Terminal UI port
description: Selects which physical port(s) the Terminal UI remote-display feature operates over (SIA, KUZU, or both interfaces).
notes: Token TERMINAL_UI_PORT; value_map: 1=SIA, 2=KUZU, 3=BOTH; SIA/KUZU are BMW internal USB/signal interface designations.

name: Simple AUX input 1
description: Enables the first simplified AUX audio input channel in the CDMM media manager, typically used for a basic analog audio line input without full metadata support.
notes: Token CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_1.

name: Simple AUX input 2
description: Enables the second simplified AUX audio input channel in the CDMM media manager.
notes: Token CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_2; value_map: 0=NICHT_AKTIV.

name: Speed lock: tuner/radio functions
description: Controls whether tuner/radio functions (e.g. station search, frequency input) are locked above a certain speed. When active, these HMI interactions are blocked while driving.
notes: Token SPEEDLOCK_HMI_TUNER; value_map: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV; always active (no FA gate).

name: RSE display brightness control
description: Enables the brightness adjustment control for rear-seat entertainment (RSE) screens in the HMI, allowing the driver or passengers to change RSE screen brightness.
notes: Token RSE_BRIGHTNESS.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 12; 86 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,12CK,12CL) / 337 M Sports package / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 12; 79 type tokens, e.g. 11DE,12DE,1A31,1A32) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 28 type tokens, e.g. 1B71,1B72,1B91,1H91) / 7AC Sport Line / 7AD Urban Line / 7S1 Modern Line / 7S2 Luxury Line / numeric value-attribute 0321 (FP category 255) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31) / 7B3 M Sport Edition / 7B1 Sport Line Edition
name: Ambient/UI colour switch (model line)
description: Enables the model-line-specific colour theme switch for the HMI and ambient lighting. When active, the system uses the colour scheme associated with the vehicle's line (Sport, Urban, Modern, Luxury).
notes: Token COLOUR_SWITCH; value_map: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV, 2=SL09.

fa_gate: 563 Lights package / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 12; 86 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,12CK,12CL) / 337 M Sports package / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 12; 79 type tokens, e.g. 11DE,12DE,1A31,1A32) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 28 type tokens, e.g. 1B71,1B72,1B91,1H91) / 7AC Sport Line / 7AD Urban Line / 7S1 Modern Line / 7S2 Luxury Line / numeric value-attribute 0321 (FP category 255) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31) / 7B3 M Sport Edition / 7B1 Sport Line Edition
name: Ambient lighting brightness control
description: Enables the ambient lighting brightness adjustment option in the HMI settings, allowing the driver to dim or brighten interior ambient light strips.
notes: Token HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT; Helligkeit=brightness, Ambilight=ambient light; German: Helligkeit Ambientelicht.

name: Colour switch line assignment
description: Sets which vehicle design line's colour theme is applied. Determines the colour accent used in the iDrive UI and ambient lighting for Sport, Urban, Modern, or Luxury Line variants.
notes: Token COLOUR_SWITCH_LINES; 3-bit field; value_map: 1=SPORT, 2=URBAN, 3=MODERN, 4=LUXURY; FA gate: 7S2 Luxury Line (and others).

name: High beam assistant (city lights)
description: Enables the High Beam Assistant (automatic main beam control) feature in the HMI, providing the on/off setting and status display for the automatic high-beam system.
notes: Token HIGH_BEAM_ASSISTANT.

fa_gate: 302 Alarm system / 838 Canadian version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: Audible lock confirmation
description: Offers a setting for a sound that confirms the car has locked when you lock it with the remote key. Enabled at the factory with the alarm system (S302) and set per market and model.

name: Torque distribution menu (xDrive/4WD)
description: Enables the torque moment distribution menu in the HMI, showing the current xDrive torque split between front and rear axles.
notes: Token MOMENTDISTRIBUTION_MENU; Momentverteilung=torque distribution; value_map only defines 1=AKTIV.

fa_gate: 838 Canadian version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93)
name: NANP phone number format
description: Enables North American Numbering Plan (NANP) phone number formatting in the HMI contact and call display, using the 10-digit +1 (NXX-NXX-XXXX) format.
notes: Token NANP_FORMAT; NANP=North American Numbering Plan.

name: Software version info request enabled
description: Enables the ability to request and display software version information from within the HMI diagnostic/about screens.
notes: Token ENABLE_SW_INFO_REQUEST; always active (no FA gate).

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 128; 192 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK)
name: Hill descent control (HDC) menu
description: Enables the Hill Descent Control (HDC) menu entry in the HMI driving aids settings, allowing the driver to activate and configure the hill descent speed assist.
notes: Token HDC; HDC=Hill Descent Control.

name: Panoramic sunroof menu
description: Enables the panoramic sunroof control entry in the HMI comfort/settings menu, providing shade and opening controls for the panoramic roof.
notes: Token PANORAMADACH; German: Panoramadach=panoramic roof.

name: Arabic/Asian date format
description: Enables the Arabic or Asian date display format variant in the HMI clock and calendar displays, using the appropriate regional format instead of the Western day/month/year convention.
notes: Token DATUMSFORMAT_AR_ASIA; Datumsformat=date format, AR=Arabic, ASIA=Asia.

name: A4A app SWT enable
description: SWT (Software Token / software-coded) enable bit for the A4A (Apps for Auto / smartphone projection) application. Decoded by the firmware switch for A4A app presence; a separate gate from the coding-only A4A bit at byte 107.
notes: Token SWT_APP_A4A; traced in firmware FUN_002f58c4 switch case 6 (A4A); read from byte 0x6e mask 0x80. See cur_desc for full trace.

name: USB profile directory name
description: Selects the brand-specific subdirectory name used by the Portation Master when importing/exporting user profiles to/from a USB drive. The directory name corresponds to the vehicle brand.
notes: Token fUSB_DATA_DIRECTORY_NAME (displayed as USB_DATA_DIRECTORY_NAME in enum dict); firmware-traced via CPortationMaster getCodingProduktlinie at FUN_002c04a4; trace strings confirm field name and values. Default/valid=6 per firmware trace but enum names 0/1/2/3/5; value 6 not in enum may be the 'BMW Evo' default.

name: Reserved (byte 111 bit 3)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed reserved bit sharing byte 111 with USB_DATA_DIRECTORY_NAME, RR_RSE_NEW_CONCEPT_INFOTAINMENT, and HMI_MAIN_MENU_VERSION. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_111_bit3.

name: Rolls-Royce RSE new infotainment concept
description: Selects the RSE (Rear-Seat Entertainment) infotainment system concept type for Rolls-Royce vehicles, enabling a new-generation RSE display architecture.
notes: Token RR_RSE_NEW_CONCEPT_INFOTAINMENT; RR=Rolls-Royce; value_map: 0=INAKTIV.

name: HMI main menu version/layout
description: Selects the main menu layout version for the iDrive HMI. Different values select alternative home-screen arrangements.
notes: Token HMI_MAIN_MENU_VERSION; value_map: 0=STANDARD.

name: Reserved (byte 112 bits 3,2,1,0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed reserved bits sharing byte 112 with A4A_LEGAL_DISCLAIMER. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_112_bits3,2,1,0.

name: A4A legal disclaimer
description: Enables the legal disclaimer screen that is displayed when the A4A (Apps for Auto / smartphone projection) session starts. Required for certain markets (Japan) and when TeleServices are active.
notes: Token A4A_LEGAL_DISCLAIMER; FA gate: 807 Japanese version / 6NR Apps / 6AE TeleServices.

name: Reserved (byte 112 bits 7,6,5)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed reserved bits sharing byte 112 with A4A_LEGAL_DISCLAIMER. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_112_bits7,6,5.

name: Voice message dictation
description: Enables the voice dictation feature for composing messages (e.g. SMS, email) using the voice control system, transcribing spoken words into text.
notes: Token MESSAGE_DICTATION; always active (no FA gate).

name: Maximum voice dictation duration
description: Sets the maximum duration in seconds allowed for a single voice dictation recording session. Higher values allow longer spoken messages.
notes: Token MAX_DICTATION_TIME_SEC; value_map: 1=V005 (5s), 2=V010 (10s), 3=V015 (15s), 4=V020 (20s), 6=V030 (30s); default=1 (5s).

name: Terminal UI link (screen mirroring link)
description: Enables the Terminal UI link function, establishing the connection between the Terminal UI remote display client and the iDrive screen rendering pipeline.
notes: Token TERMINAL_UI_LINK; always active (no FA gate). Companion to TERMINAL_UI (byte 108 bit1) and TERMINAL_UI_PORT.

name: Reserved (byte 113 bits 7,6,5)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed reserved bits sharing byte 113 with MESSAGE_DICTATION, MAX_DICTATION_TIME_SEC, and TERMINAL_UI_LINK. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_113_bits7,6,5.

name: Reserved (bytes 114–126)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed 13-byte block following the MESSAGE_DICTATION / TERMINAL_UI_LINK fields. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c; likely consumed by the HMI/GUI process on the Jacinto node.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_BYTES_114_126; spans bytes 114–126.

name: Reserved (byte 127 bits 5–0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed 6-bit field sharing byte 127 with ECO_SLOPE_ON_OFF and ECO_CURVE_ON_OFF. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_127_bits5,4,3,2,1,0.

name: ECO Pro slope guidance on/off
description: Enables the ECO Pro slope/gradient driving guidance feature, which adjusts acceleration and deceleration coaching on hills to maximise fuel economy.
notes: Token ECO_SLOPE_ON_OFF; default=1 (enabled); always active.

name: ECO Pro curve guidance on/off
description: Enables the ECO Pro curve/cornering guidance feature, providing coaching to lift off the accelerator before bends to save fuel.
notes: Token ECO_CURVE_ON_OFF; default=1 (enabled); always active.

name: ECO Pro transmission guidance on/off
description: Enables the ECO Pro transmission (gearshift) coaching guidance, advising the driver when to upshift for optimal fuel economy.
notes: Token ECO_TRANS_ON_OFF; default=1 (enabled); always active.

name: ECO Pro auxiliary consumers guidance on/off
description: Enables ECO Pro coaching for auxiliary electrical consumers (climate, seat heating, etc.), advising the driver to reduce consumption to improve efficiency.
notes: Token ECO_AUX_ON_OFF; default=1.

name: ECO PRO route: ferry consumption factor
description: Sets the factor that the navigation's ECO PRO (energy-saving) route calculation applies to ferry sections when it estimates a route's fuel or energy use, from 0 to 4 times.

name: ECO Pro tips new layout
description: Enables the new-generation ECO Pro tips/coaching screen layout, replacing the legacy layout with an updated visual design.
notes: Token ECO_TIPS_LAYOUT_NEW.

name: ECO Pro one-pedal drive tips
description: Enables ECO Pro coaching tips specific to one-pedal driving technique (lift-off coasting/regeneration), relevant for hybrid and EV models.
notes: Token ECO_TIPPS_ONEPADDLEDRIVE; value_map: 0=NICHT_AKTIV.

name: Reserved (byte 128 bit 7)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed reserved bit sharing byte 128 with ECO_TRANS_ON_OFF, ECO_AUX_ON_OFF, ECO_FERRY_CONS, ECO_TIPS_LAYOUT_NEW, and ECO_TIPPS_ONEPADDLEDRIVE. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_128_bit7.

name: Reserved (byte 129 bits 5–0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed 6-bit field sharing byte 129 with DOOR_LOCK_AFTER_DRIVING_AWAY and A4A_VOICE_APP_SUPPORT. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_129_bits5,4,3,2,1,0.

name: Auto door lock when driving away
description: Enables automatic door locking when the vehicle reaches a set speed after pulling away, without requiring the driver to manually lock the doors.
notes: Token DOOR_LOCK_AFTER_DRIVING_AWAY; always active (no FA gate).

name: A4A voice app support
description: Enables voice command integration for A4A (Apps for Auto) smartphone apps, allowing connected apps to be controlled via the vehicle's voice recognition system.
notes: Token A4A_VOICE_APP_SUPPORT.

name: Reserved (byte 130 bits 5–0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed 6-bit field sharing byte 130 with DEPARTURE_TIME_CLIMATE and COVER_FLOW. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_130_bits5,4,3,2,1,0.

name: Departure time climate pre-conditioning
description: Enables the departure time pre-conditioning feature, allowing the user to schedule the climate control to reach the desired temperature before entering the vehicle.
notes: Token DEPARTURE_TIME_CLIMATE.

name: Cover Flow album browser
description: Enables the Cover Flow album artwork browser in the audio/media player, displaying album art in a horizontally-scrollable 3D carousel view.
notes: Token COVER_FLOW.

name: Reserved (bytes 131–132)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Unnamed 2-byte block following DEPARTURE_TIME_CLIMATE and COVER_FLOW. No consumer found in NBTCarHU.c.
notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_BYTES_131_132.

notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_133_bits1,0.

name: Brand theme
description: Sets which brand's look the head unit uses, including logos, colors and menu styling. Set it to match the car's brand.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: M model
description: Tells the head unit the car is a BMW M model, so it offers M-specific menus and graphics. Enable it only on an M model.

name: M Drive systems enable
description: Enables the full M Drive Systems integration, activating M-specific powertrain and chassis control displays and settings menus (M differential, M suspension modes, etc.).
notes: Token M_DRIVE_SYSTEMS.

name: Traction demand control menu
description: Enables the traction demand control menu in the HMI, which may allow selection of traction/all-wheel-drive demand mode settings for compatible drivetrains.
notes: Token TRACTION_DEMAND_CONTROL.

fa_gate: 606 Navigation system Business / 609 Professional navigation system / 249 Multifunction for steering wheel / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Voice control barge-in
description: Enables the voice control barge-in feature, allowing the driver to start speaking a voice command without pressing a button, even while audio is playing. Requires navigation and steering wheel buttons.
notes: Token BARGEIN; FA gate: navigation options + multifunction steering wheel (249).

name: Reserved (byte 134 bit 5)

name: Google local voice search
description: Enables Google-powered local voice search integration, allowing the user to search for points of interest and information using Google voice recognition.
notes: Token GOOGLE_LOCAL_VOICE_SEARCH.

name: Emergency warning broadcasts
description: Shows emergency warning messages that broadcasters send over digital radio or TV as a pop-up on the central display, in markets where such warnings are broadcast.

name: A4A speech-to-text speller input
description: Enables speech-to-text (STT) input for the A4A speller, allowing the user to dictate text into A4A connected app text fields using the vehicle's microphone.
notes: Token A4A_STT_SPELLER_INPUT; STT=speech-to-text; default=1; active when NOT 6NR Apps (i.e. when A4A uses STT fallback) or with Infotainment control/TeleServices.

name: A4A status bar notifications
description: Enables notification display from A4A connected smartphone apps in the iDrive status bar, showing app alerts and incoming notifications.
notes: Token A4A_STATUS_BAR_NOTIFICATION; default=1.

name: A4A calendar widget
description: Enables the calendar/agenda widget for A4A connected apps, displaying upcoming appointments from the connected smartphone's calendar on the iDrive home screen.
notes: Token A4A_CALENDER_WIDGET; default=1.

notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_135_bits7,6,5,4,3.

name: Ambient/UI colour ensemble (Rolls-Royce)
description: Selects the ambient lighting and UI colour ensemble for Rolls-Royce vehicles, corresponding to the vehicle's interior colour scheme option.
notes: Token COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE; 3-bit field; value_map: 0=NICHT_AKTIV.

name: Standstill rule for Office messages
description: Sets the standstill condition the head unit checks before it lifts the driving lock on Office messages: none, the parking brake set, the transmission in Park, both or either one. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Text while driving: My Info messages
