fa_gate: 807 Japanese version / 810 Australian version / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 17; 33 type tokens, e.g. 1F53,1F73,1F93,1G93) / 8LH Country control 04142 / 8LT Country control 04825
name: Text while driving: AKD messages

name: Text while driving: BMW Info messages

name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 1
description: First map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay. When the navigation map reaches this zoom level, the inductive charging position indicator behaviour changes.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_1; full byte numeric, example values 0 and 100; always active (no FA gate).

name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 2
description: Second map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_2; example values 0 and 60; always active.

name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 3
description: Third map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_3; example values 0 and 30; always active.

name: Wireless charging tray X position (CPM)
description: Sets the X-axis position of the wireless charging tray indicator overlay on the camera/map view, in centimetres relative to the charging position marker (CPM).
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSXCPM; 2-byte value (bytes 142–143), type type0x63, default 0x07FF; CPM=charging position marker. Always active.

name: Wireless charging tray Y position (CPM)
description: Sets the Y-axis position of the wireless charging tray indicator overlay on the camera/map view, in centimetres relative to the charging position marker.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSYCPM; 2-byte value (bytes 144–145), type type0x63, default 0x07FF; CPM=charging position marker. Always active.

name: Speed lock: lower speed threshold
description: Sets the speed the car must slow to before the speed locks on the central display are lifted again; at 0 km/h they stay on until the car stops. Keep it below “Speed lock: upper speed threshold” (`3000/147/00111111b`). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Reserved (byte 146 bits 7,6,5)

notes: resolved_unnamed entry: RESERVED_3000_146_bits7,6,5.

description: Sets the speed above which the speed locks on the central display take effect. They are lifted again once the car slows to “Speed lock: lower speed threshold” (`3000/146/00011111b`). If this value isn't above the lower threshold, the head unit uses the lower threshold plus 1 km/h. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

name: Air ioniser
description: Enables the interior air ioniser function in the HMI, providing the control menu for the cabin air ionisation system.
notes: Token IONISATOR; German: Ionisator=ioniser.

name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 4
description: Fourth map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_4; example values 0 and 60; always active.

name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 5
description: Fifth map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.
notes: Token INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_5; example values 0 and 30; always active.

name: FBM: Entertainment shortcut
description: Controls whether the Entertainment shortcut appears in the favorites/function-bar menu (FBM = Favoritenband-Menü). When active, a direct-access button for the audio/entertainment source is shown.
notes: Token: FBM_ENT.

name: FBM: Telephone shortcut
description: Controls whether the Phone shortcut appears in the favorites/function-bar menu.
notes: Token: FBM_TEL.

name: FBM: Navigation shortcut

name: FM de-emphasis

notes: Token FM_DEEMPHASIS; no symbolic enum in syset (raw codes only); values inferred from BMW/radio industry convention for this token.

name: Minimum gap between equal-priority chimes
description: Sets how long the head unit waits after playing a chime before it plays another chime of the same priority; one that comes sooner isn't played. Best left unchanged.

name: Chime timeout
description: Longest time a continuous chime keeps sounding without a new request from the module that asked for it. Best left unchanged.
notes: Not a user setting: Chime watchdog timing: AudioProcess CPJingleDevCtrl FUN_00288c50 reads byte 2 x 20 ms (BMW 250 = 5000 ms, also the built-in default) and the jingle processors restart this timer on every 'on' request of a continuous chime (and the reverse-gear chime), stopping it when no request follows. Only matters when a module's 'off' request is lost: protocol timing, hidden (decision 2).

name: Switch-on volume limit
description: When the audio system switches on, a volume left above this level is lowered to it, so it doesn't start too loud. The level is a step on the head unit's volume scale.

name: Rear-seat switch-on volume limit
description: When the rear-seat entertainment switches on, a rear volume left above this level is lowered to it, so it doesn't start too loud. The level is a step on the rear volume scale. Only relevant with rear-seat entertainment.

name: Rear-seat volume limits
description: Sets two limits for the rear-seat entertainment volume: the top of its volume scale and the lower maximum used in the child ear-protection mode. Best left unchanged.
notes: Not a user setting: Two packed quantities, not one number: AudioProcess FUN_002ab210 reads bytes 5-6 whole ('getMaxVolumeStepRse codMaxVolumeStepRse = 0x%4X') and FUN_002ab2a0 splits them, high byte = rear volume steps, low byte = child ear-protection limit ('writeVolumeStepsMaxRse %d and in Child Ear Protection %d'); a whole-field number would mean neither.

name: RDS function enable
description: Enables or disables Radio Data System (RDS) reception and display (station name, programme type, AF, TP/TA announcements).

name: SiriusXM album cover art display

name: RSE headphone 180-degree audio rotation

name: SiriusXM Smart Favourites

name: Software update: shutdown timeout enable
description: When enabled, a watchdog shutdown timer is active during software update (SWUP) operations to prevent the vehicle being stranded with a partially updated system if the process stalls.
notes: Token SwupEnableShutdownTimeout (firmware log) / SWUP_ENABLE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT (syset descriptor). Firmware-traced: CUpdateAgentSysSettings reader FUN_001fe958, accessor FUN_00333e2c.

name: Software update agent role

name: Software update: separate/sequential updates enable
description: When enabled, software updates are applied to each SWE (Software Element) separately in sequence rather than in a combined package, allowing more granular retry/rollback behaviour.

notes: FES_SPORT_EXPERT — typically the M-car SPORT+ / SPORT Expert variant. No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT CUSTOM driving mode available
description: Enables a user-configurable SPORT CUSTOM driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu, allowing individual sub-system settings within the SPORT programme.
notes: FES_SPORT_CUSTOM — the 'Individual/Custom' variant of SPORT mode. No symbolic enum values.

name: COMFORT BASE driving mode available
description: Enables the COMFORT (base) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu. Standard COMFORT programme selection.
notes: FES_COMFORT_BASE. No symbolic enum values.

name: COMFORT PLUS driving mode available
description: Enables the COMFORT PLUS (enhanced comfort) driving mode within the Driving Experience Control system.
notes: FES_COMFORT_PLUS. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO BASE driving mode available
description: Enables the ECO PRO (base) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu. Base efficiency programme offering fuel-saving coaching.
notes: FES_ECO_BASE. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO PLUS driving mode available
description: Enables the ECO PRO PLUS driving mode, which adds extended coasting/sailing and additional energy-saving measures beyond ECO PRO base.
notes: FES_ECO_PLUS. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO CUSTOM driving mode available
description: Enables a user-configurable ECO PRO CUSTOM driving mode, letting the driver individually adjust ECO-related sub-systems.
notes: FES_ECO_CUSTOM. No symbolic enum values.

name: ADAPTIVE driving mode available
description: Enables the ADAPTIVE driving mode, which dynamically adjusts suspension, steering, and drivetrain based on current driving style.
notes: FES_ADAPTIVE — requires Adaptive suspension/active chassis hardware. No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.
notes: SPORT_CONF_ATTENUATION. Attenuation = Dämpfung (suspension damping). No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT mode: steering configurable
description: When set, the steering weight/ratio is individually configurable within the SPORT driving mode.
notes: SPORT_CONF_STEERING. No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT mode: engine response configurable
description: When set, the engine throttle/response mapping is individually configurable within the SPORT driving mode.
notes: SPORT_CONF_ENGINE. No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT mode: transmission type
description: Identifies the gearbox type present, which determines which SPORT mode gear-shift configuration options are offered (manual vs automatic Sport programmes).
notes: SPORT_CONF_GEAR_TYPE. Enum: 1=HANDSCHALTER (manual), 2=AUTOMATIK (automatic). Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: SPORT mode: driver seat configurable
description: When set, the front driver's seat (bolster/position) is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.
notes: SPORT_CONF_SEAT. No symbolic enum values.

name: SPORT mode: auto start/stop (MSA) configurable
description: When set, the auto start/stop (MSA — Motor-Start-Automatik) function is individually selectable within the SPORT driving mode.
notes: SPORT_CONF_MSA. MSA = Motor-Start-Automatik (auto stop/start). No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the ECO PRO driving mode configuration.
notes: ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: steering configurable
description: When set, the steering weight is individually configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_STEERING. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: coasting/sailing configurable
description: When set, the engine sailing/coasting function (engine-off coasting to save fuel) is individually selectable within the ECO PRO mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_SAILING. Sailing = engine-off coasting (Segeln). No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: seat heating configurable
description: When set, seat heating availability/behaviour is configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode (seat heating may be reduced to save energy).
notes: ECO_CONF_SEATHEATING. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: climate control configurable
description: When set, the climate control (AC compressor / heating) setting is individually configurable within the ECO PRO mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_CLIMATE. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: lights and visibility scope
description: Selects which energy consumers ECO PRO mode governs: either lights and visibility systems (e.g. rear defroster), or visibility systems only.
notes: ECO_CONF_LIGHT_SIGHT. Enum: 1=LICHT_UND_SICHT (lights and sight), 2=SICHT (sight/visibility only). Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: ECO PRO mode: speed limiter configurable
description: When set, the speed limiter function is individually configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode (ECO speed cap).
notes: ECO_CONF_LIMIT. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: speed limit assistant (VZA) configurable
description: When set, the speed limit assistant (VZA — Verkehrszeichen-Assistent / traffic-sign recognition) behaviour is configurable within ECO PRO mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_VZA. VZA = Verkehrszeichen-Assistent (traffic sign assistant / speed limit recognition). No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: CID tips/hints active
description: Controls whether ECO PRO tips and coaching hints are shown on the Central Information Display (CID). When inactive, the on-screen ECO coaching overlay is suppressed.
notes: ECO_CONF_CID_TIPPS. Enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV. Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: SPORT mode: co-driver seat configurable
description: When set, the front passenger (co-driver) seat bolster/position is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.
notes: SPORT_CONF_SEAT_CODRIVER. No symbolic enum values.

name: Driving Experience Control: reset configuration available
description: When set, a reset option is offered in the Driving Experience Control configuration menu, allowing the user to revert all driving mode settings to factory defaults.
notes: FES_CONF_RESET. No symbolic enum values.

name: COMFORT PLUS mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the COMFORT PLUS driving mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION_COMFPLUS — attenuation sub-option for the COMFORT PLUS variant. No symbolic enum values.

name: COMFORT PLUS mode: steering configurable
description: When set, the steering weight/ratio is individually configurable within the COMFORT PLUS driving mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_STEERING_COMFPLUS. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: speed limit text display style
description: Selects how the ECO PRO speed limit notification is presented on the display — as a hint/advisory text at activation, or as an active limit indicator while driving.
notes: ECO_CONF_LIMIT_TEXT. Enum: 0=HINWEIS_BEI (hint/note at), 1=LIMIT_BEI (limit/cap at). Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: Stability control (DSC) mode-change popup
description: When set, a popup/warning notification is displayed when the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) mode is changed via the Driving Experience Control settings.
notes: STABILITY_CONTROL_POPUP. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode: auto start/stop (MSA) configurable
description: When set, the auto start/stop (MSA) function is individually selectable within the ECO PRO driving mode.
notes: ECO_CONF_MSA. MSA = Motor-Start-Automatik. No symbolic enum values.

name: Global coasting/sailing configurable
description: When set, the engine sailing/coasting function is available as a global (vehicle-level) configurable option, not tied to a specific driving mode.
notes: GLOBAL_CONF_SAILING. No symbolic enum values.

name: Rolls-Royce DSC-OFF mode available
description: Indicates that the DSC-OFF (Dynamic Stability Control fully off) mode is available. The 'RR' prefix in the token designates a Rolls-Royce vehicle variant; this flag is not applicable to standard xDrive or F-series vehicles.
notes: RR_DSCOFF_AVL. RR = Rolls-Royce (BMW engineering prefix). No symbolic enum values. No syset enum names. Prior description hallucinated 'Rear roll stabilisation' and 'xDrive' — neither is supported by the token.

name: Undocumented field (FES byte 4, bits 7-4)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. A 4-bit field in the FES (Feature-Enable Set) coding page at byte 4, bits 7-4 (mask 0xF0). Active on this vehicle but no symbolic enum or individual token name is available.
notes: Token: 'FES byte 4 (4-bit field (00.00))'. Opaque positional field within the FES page. No resolved_unnamed entry. No symbolic enum values.

name: Undocumented field (FES bytes 5-77, multi-byte block)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources at this granularity. A multi-byte block spanning bytes 5 through 77 of the FES (Feature-Enable Set) coding page. Individual named fields within this range (VIDEO_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION, CONNECTED_DRIVE, NFC_SMART_ACCESS, A4A_SWT, IPCE_WEBSERVER, etc.) are resolved in other chunks; this single CAFD record covers the unresolved interior.
notes: Token: 'FES byte 5 (multi-byte value (syset Int/UInt8/16))'. Opaque catch-all block; byte range 5-77. No resolved_unnamed entry. Known named fields in this page include VIDEO_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION, SPEEDLOCK_SPEEDVALUE_MAX, CONNECTED_DRIVE, NFC_SMART_ACCESS, A4A_SWT, IPCE_WEBSERVER, MESSAGE_DICTATION, GOOGLE_LOCAL_VOICE_SEARCH, ENT_MC_PIA, TIMESHIFT_REC, ENT_VIDEO_BLUERAY, RSE_SEAT thresholds, ARMREST_ALL_CONTROL, DUFT_IONISATOR, WEEKLY_TIMER, ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_NEW, BARGEIN, M_DIGITAL_TACHO.

name: Undocumented field (FES byte 78, bits 3-0)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. A 4-bit field in the FES coding page at byte 78, bits 3-0 (mask 0x0F). Active on this vehicle but no symbolic enum or individual token name is available.
notes: Token: 'FES byte 78 (4-bit field (00.00))'. Opaque positional field. Shares byte 78 with ECO_PRO_HINT (bit4), ECO_INFO_DISPLAY (bit5), EFF_DYN_SAILING (bit6), ECO_TIPPS (bit7). No resolved_unnamed entry. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO hint display style
description: Selects how ECO PRO mode activation hints are shown — as an advisory message at the point of activation (HINWEIS_BEI), or as an active limit indicator during driving (LIMIT_BEI).
notes: ECO_PRO_HINT. Enum: 0=HINWEIS_BEI, 1=LIMIT_BEI. Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: ECO info display enabled
description: When set, ECO PRO mode information (fuel saving indicators, efficiency data) is shown on the Central Information Display during ECO PRO operation.
notes: ECO_INFO_DISPLAY. No symbolic enum values.

fa_gate: NOT 205 Steptronic transmission / 812 Great Britain/Ireland version / 2TB Steptronic sport transmission / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 23 type tokens, e.g. 1A10,1A11,1A12,1A31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 23; 265 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK)
name: Efficiency/dynamic coasting (sailing) available
description: When active, the engine sailing/coasting function (engine-off free-roll to save fuel) is available as an efficiency-dynamic feature on this vehicle. Gate excludes Steptronic and certain market/type variants.
notes: EFF_DYN_SAILING. Enum: 0=NICHT_AKTIV, 1=AKTIV. Values confirmed from syset value_map. FA-gated: excluded for 205 Steptronic / 812 GB-IE / 2TB Steptronic Sport / certain type-key groups.

name: ECO PRO tips/coaching enabled
description: When set, ECO PRO driving tips and efficiency coaching messages are enabled and displayed to the driver during ECO PRO operation.
notes: ECO_TIPPS (Tipps = tips/hints). No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO route function enabled
description: When set, the ECO PRO navigation route optimisation function (fuel-efficient routing) is enabled, allowing the system to suggest or follow more economical routes.
notes: ECO_ROUTE. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO speed limit function enabled
description: When set, the ECO PRO speed limit/cap function is enabled, providing a driver-configurable top-speed limit within ECO PRO mode to maximise efficiency.
notes: ECO_LIMIT. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode enabled
description: Master enable for the ECO PRO driving mode. When set, ECO PRO appears as a selectable mode in the Driving Experience Control menu.
notes: ECO_MODE. No symbolic enum values.

name: ECO PRO mode configurable by user
description: When set, the ECO PRO mode parameters (climate, seat heating, etc.) are user-adjustable via the settings menu, enabling the ECO PRO Individual/Custom sub-mode.
notes: ECO_MODE_CONF. No symbolic enum values.

name: Driving Experience Control UI naming scheme
description: Selects the naming/labelling convention used in the Driving Experience Control menu — either the post-July 2011 (current) naming or the earlier (pre-July 2011) naming scheme.
notes: FDS_NAMING_MODE. Enum: 0=AB_0711 (from 07/2011), 1=BIS_0711 (until 07/2011). FDS = Fahrdynamik-System naming. Values confirmed from syset value_map.

name: Driving Experience Control popup deactivated
description: When set, the introductory/welcome popup shown when the Driving Experience Control menu is first accessed is suppressed.
notes: FDS_POPUP_DEACTIVATE. FDS = Fahrdynamik-System (Driving Experience Control). No symbolic enum values.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 7 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33,2T73) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 27 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 3 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33)
name: Driving mode switch display
description: Chooses how the head unit responds when the driver uses the driving mode switch: no display, a pop-up showing the selected mode, or that pop-up plus pages for configuring the modes.

name: EfficientDynamics drivetrain type (ECO display)
description: Selects the powertrain variant used by the EfficientDynamics / ECO display subsystem to determine which energy-flow gauges and history charts to render. Must match the vehicle's actual powertrain; conventional petrol is value 0.
notes: ECO_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN; enum fully resolved from syset descriptor. This is the CAFD-level ECO display variant selector; EFF_DYN_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN (byte 9) is the companion field for the EfficientDynamics page layout.

name: ASD (active sound design) installed
description: Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with Active Sound Design (ASD) — the electronic engine sound synthesis system. When set, ASD sound profile fields in this page are evaluated.
notes: ASD_CONFIGURATION; single-bit presence flag. No symbolic enum names in syset dict; values inferred from bit semantics.

name: ASD sound output disable
description: When active, suppresses ASD audio output — the artificial engine sound is muted regardless of drive mode. Allows the system to be installed but silenced for specific market/variant configurations.
notes: ASD_SOUND_OFF; no symbolic enum in syset dict; bit meaning derived from token name.

name: ASD sound profile 1 available
description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 1. Each ASD_SOUND_n bit makes a specific synthesized sound profile available for selection in the drive-mode setup.
notes: ASD_SOUND_1; enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

name: ASD sound profile 2 available
description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 2. Corresponds to a second synthesized engine-sound variant selectable in drive modes.
notes: ASD_SOUND_2; no symbolic enum in syset dict; bit semantics by token parallel to ASD_SOUND_1.

name: ASD sound profile 3 available
description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 3. Third synthesized engine-sound variant for drive-mode selection.
notes: ASD_SOUND_3; no symbolic enum in syset dict; bit semantics by token parallel to ASD_SOUND_1.

name: ASD sound profile 4 available
description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 4. Fourth synthesized engine-sound variant for drive-mode selection.
notes: ASD_SOUND_4; no symbolic enum in syset dict; bit semantics by token parallel to ASD_SOUND_1.

name: EfficientDynamics history zoom
description: Enables zoom interaction on the EfficientDynamics consumption-history bar chart, allowing the driver to expand individual time segments for detail.
notes: HIST_ZOOM; enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

fa_gate: NOT vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 7 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33,2T73) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 27 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 3 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33)
name: EfficientDynamics drive-mode name display
description: Controls whether the FDS (Fahrdynamiksystem / drive-mode system) mode name is shown as a text label in the EfficientDynamics history view. FA-gated: suppressed on certain vehicle type-key groups (electrified/entry variants).
notes: HIST_FDS_MODE_NAME; FDS=Fahrdynamiksystem (drive-dynamics system); no symbolic enum in syset dict.

fa_gate: NOT vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 13; 7 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33,2T73) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 27 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 3 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33)
name: EfficientDynamics drive-mode colour coding
description: Enables colour-coding of FDS (drive-mode) segments in the EfficientDynamics history chart, distinguishing Comfort/Sport/Eco segments by bar colour.
notes: HIST_FDS_MODE_COLOR; no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: EfficientDynamics average consumption display mode
description: Selects which average-consumption value is shown in the history view. Numeric code; no symbolic names in firmware.
notes: HIST_CONSUMP_AVERAGE; 2-bit field, observed raw codes [0,1,2,3]; no symbolic enum.

name: Drive Experience statistics reset
description: When enabled, allows the Drive Experience trip statistics to be reset by the driver from the iDrive menu.
notes: DRIVE_EXP_RESET; enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

name: Drive Experience brake-regen widget
description: Enables the brake-regeneration (BRW = Bremsenrückgewinnung) widget in the Drive Experience / EfficientDynamics display, showing energy recovered under braking.
notes: DRIVE_EXP_BRW; BRW=Bremsenrückgewinnung (brake energy recovery); enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

fa_gate: NOT vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Drive Experience feature available
description: Master enable for the Drive Experience analysis feature. When active, the Drive Experience page is accessible in the iDrive menu. FA-gated: suppressed on specific base vehicle type-key group.
notes: DRIVE_EXPERIENCE; no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: EV charging hospitality feature
description: Enables the 'charging hospitality' function for plug-in vehicles — locating and routing to charging stations with amenities. Only relevant for PHEV/BEV variants.
notes: CHARGING_HOSPITALITY; only value 0=INAKTIV in syset dict; PHEV/BEV-only feature.

name: EfficientDynamics history UI variant (DXE)
description: Selects which generation of the EfficientDynamics history display layout (DXE = Driving Experience) is used. Controls whether the newer or older bar-chart variant is rendered.
notes: HIST_PRESENT_VARIANT_DXE; DXE=Driving Experience; enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

name: Driving style analysis animation
description: Enables the animated graphical display in the Fahrstilanalyse (driving style analysis) view — shows leaf/arc animations reflecting eco-driving score.
notes: FAHRSTILANALYSE_ANIMATION; Fahrstilanalyse=driving style analysis; no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: Undocumented field (EFFICIENT_DYNAMICS byte 3, 6-bit)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. A 6-bit packed field in the EFFICIENT_DYNAMICS coding page whose individual sub-fields are not individually pinned by the firmware name table. Default 0x00.
notes: Token is a synthetic placeholder from the build_map positional encoder (not a real BMW name). No syset enum, no resolved_unnamed entry. Likely contains HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_3 or similar sub-fields not individually mapped.

fa_gate: NOT vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Driving style analysis feature available
description: Master enable for the Fahrstilanalyse (driving style analysis) page — an EfficientDynamics sub-page scoring driver eco-behaviour. FA-gated: suppressed on specific base vehicle type-key group.
notes: FAHRSTILANALYSE; Fahrstilanalyse=driving style analysis; no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 6
description: Sets the sixth configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. This is one of a series of scale-step fields (HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_1.6) that define chart grid lines. Numeric value; no symbolic names.
notes: HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_6; 3-bit field, observed raw codes [0,2,4]; no symbolic enum.

name: EfficientDynamics petrol consumption bar visible
description: Enables the petrol/gas consumption column in the EfficientDynamics history bar chart. FA-gated on KOMBI extended equipment or specific vehicle type-key group.
notes: HIST_GAS_CONSUMP; enum confirmed from syset descriptor. Value 0 is implied 'not active' (no symbolic code 0 present).

name: Sailing (coasting) counter display
description: Enables the sailing/coasting counter widget in the EfficientDynamics view, showing the cumulative duration or count of engine-off coast events (BMW 'Sailing' function).
notes: SAILING_COUNTER; 'Sailing' = engine-off coasting mode on applicable BMW models; no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: Electric drive menu
description: Controls whether the head unit offers its electric drive menu, and which version: the one for plug-in hybrids or the one for electric cars with a range extender (REX). Set it to match the car's powertrain.

name: PHEV energy management (VEM) available
description: Enables the Vehicle Energy Management (VEM) display for plug-in hybrid variants, showing the charge/discharge balance between petrol and electric drive. Inactive on non-PHEV vehicles.
notes: VEM_PHEV_AVAILABLE; VEM=Verbrauchsenergie-Management (vehicle energy management); no symbolic enum in syset dict.

name: Consumption chart top value (L/100 km)
description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in L/100 km. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

fa_gate: vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Consumption chart top value (mpg, UK)
description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in UK (imperial) miles per gallon. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

name: EfficientDynamics hybrid type
description: Specifies the hybrid architecture used by this vehicle for EfficientDynamics display purposes. Determines which energy-flow view (pure ICE vs belt/axle hybrid vs parallel hybrid) is rendered.

name: Sport display on central display

name: Sport display unit

description: Selects the CAN signal source used to display battery state-of-charge (SoC) in the EfficientDynamics view. Only relevant for hybrid/electric variants.
notes: SOC_DISP_SIGNAL; SoC=State of Charge; enum confirmed from syset descriptor.

name: Seat heating as energy consumer (EfficientDynamics)
description: Registers the seat heating system as a tracked energy consumer in the EfficientDynamics display, contributing to the auxiliary load breakdown. Only relevant on equipped vehicles.

name: Charging cable port position

notes: CHARGING_CABLE_SIDE; enum confirmed from syset descriptor; Stecker=plug/connector.

name: EfficientDynamics hybrid forecast display variant
description: Selects which variant of the hybrid energy-forecast view is displayed in the EfficientDynamics section. Used on HEV/PHEV models to show predictive charge-depletion or route-based energy planning.
notes: EFF_DYN_FORECAST_HYB; enum confirmed from syset descriptor; WERT=value/variant. Value 0 has no symbolic syset name.

name: Hybrid consumption bar in history chart
description: Enables a separate hybrid-mode (electric) consumption bar alongside the petrol bar in the EfficientDynamics history chart. Only meaningful on HEV/PHEV variants.
notes: HIST_HYB_CONSUMP; no symbolic enum in syset dict; bit meaning from token and context.

name: Hybrid consumption history scale — step 2
description: Second Y-axis reference scale value for the hybrid consumption history chart. Default 0x14 (=20 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.
notes: HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_2; observed raw codes [20]; default 0x14=20.

name: Hybrid consumption history scale — step 3
description: Third Y-axis reference scale value for the hybrid consumption history chart. Default 0x1E (=30 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.
notes: HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_3; default 0x1E=30. Syset observed raw code 0 (some variant uses 0).

name: Hybrid / EV consumption chart display switch
description: Enables the ability to toggle between hybrid and EV consumption views in the EfficientDynamics history display. Allows switching between PHEV electric and petrol history segments.

name: Driver assistance display stage
description: Selects how the head unit presents driver assistance warnings, from simple status panels to one of two full display concepts. Best left unchanged.

name: Forward collision warning (AUFFAHRWARNUNG)
description: Enables the rear-end / tailgating collision warning function that alerts the driver when following distance becomes dangerously short.
notes: AUFFAHRWARNUNG = rear-end collision / tailgate warning. Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV}. Only one documented value.

name: Lane positioning display (LANE_POSITIONING)
description: Enables on-screen lane-positioning display showing vehicle position within the current lane relative to lane markings.
notes: LANE_POSITIONING is an English-language token. Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV}. Only one documented value.

name: Pedestrian warning (daytime) (PERSONENWARNUNG_TAGS)
description: Configures the daytime pedestrian detection and warning capability, alerting the driver when a pedestrian is detected in or near the vehicle's path.
notes: PERSONENWARNUNG = person/pedestrian warning; TAGS = daytime. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Value 0 has no symbolic name.

name: Pedestrian warning (nighttime) (PERSONENWARNUNG_NACHTS)
description: Configures the nighttime pedestrian detection and warning function, typically using Night Vision (NIVI) camera data.
notes: PERSONENWARNUNG_NACHTS = nighttime pedestrian warning. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Value 0 has no symbolic name.

name: Lane departure warning version
description: Tells the head unit which version of lane departure warning the car has, so its settings and displays match. With generation 2 the Intelligent Safety menu labels one warning setting “Early” instead of “Always”, and notices can name a deactivated Lane Departure Warning or reduced steering intervention. Set at the factory with Lane departure warning (S5AD) or Driving Assistant (S5AS).

name: Lane change warning generation (SPURWECHSELWARNUNG)
description: Selects the generation/variant of the lane change warning function (blind spot monitor style warning when changing lanes).
notes: SPURWECHSELWARNUNG = lane-change warning. Enum value_map: {2:GEN_2}. Value 0 has no symbolic name (not in map). Value 1 does not appear in the descriptor.

name: Side collision warning (SEITENKOLLISIONSWARNUNG)
description: Enables the side collision warning function, which alerts the driver to objects alongside the vehicle that could cause a side impact.
notes: SEITENKOLLISIONSWARNUNG = side/lateral collision warning. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Lane departure warning min. speed (km/h)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which lane departure warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Lane change warning min. speed (km/h)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which lane change warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Targeted headlight illumination (GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN)
description: Enables directed/targeted headlight illumination — the system that actively steers a spotlight toward a detected pedestrian or obstacle at night.
notes: GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN = targeted illumination (gezieltes Anleuchten). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Earlier token vs GEZIELTES_ANLEUCHTEN at byte 49.

name: Cruise control (AUTOTEMPOMAT)
description: Enables cruise control (Tempomat) — the speed-hold function displayed/managed via the HU Driving Assistant page.
notes: AUTOTEMPOMAT = automatic cruise control (German Tempomat = cruise control). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Previous description said 'Active cruise control (ACC)' implying radar-based adaptive CC; AUTOTEMPOMAT without 'ADAPTIV' prefix means standard cruise control (speed hold), not adaptive. Description corrected.

name: Speed limiter (AUTOLIMITER)
description: Enables the automatic speed limiter function, which prevents the vehicle from exceeding a set maximum speed.
notes: AUTOLIMITER = automatic speed limiter. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Lane departure warning timing (SPURVERLASSENSWARNZEITPUNKT)
description: Selects when (how early) the lane departure warning triggers — the timing point relative to crossing the lane marking. Raw descriptor codes are 1 and 2; no symbolic names are defined.
notes: SPURVERLASSENSWARNZEITPUNKT = lane-departure warning timing point. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1,2]). Previous version labelled values as 'Early' and 'Late' — these labels have no enum source and are fabricated. Per Rule 3, multi-bit field with no symbolic map uses values:{}.

name: Lane departure warning min. speed (mph)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which lane departure warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Lane change warning min. speed (mph)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which lane change warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Lane change warning timing (SPURWECHSELWARNZEITPUNKT)
description: Selects the timing point at which the lane change warning triggers relative to the lane crossing event. Raw descriptor codes are 1 and 2; no symbolic names are defined.
notes: SPURWECHSELWARNZEITPUNKT = lane-change warning timing point. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1,2]). Previous version labelled values as 'Early' and 'Late' — these labels have no enum source and are fabricated. Per Rule 3, multi-bit field with no symbolic map uses values:{}.

name: Steering wheel vibration (VIBRATIONSSTAERKE)
description: Enables/disables the steering wheel haptic vibration used to alert the driver during lane departure or lane change warnings. This is a binary on/off field.
notes: VIBRATIONSSTAERKE = vibration strength/intensity. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Field is 2-bit but only raw code 1 is documented; description corrected to reflect binary on/off rather than 'sets the intensity' (which implies a range).

name: Lane departure steering intervention (SPURVERLASSENSLENKEINGRIFF)
description: Enables active steering counter-correction when the vehicle is about to depart its lane — the system applies a corrective steering torque.
notes: SPURVERLASSENSLENKEINGRIFF = lane-departure steering intervention. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Lane change steering intervention (SPURWECHSELLENKEINGRIFF)
description: Enables active steering counter-correction during an unintentional lane change — system applies corrective torque to prevent drifting into an adjacent lane.
notes: SPURWECHSELLENKEINGRIFF = lane-change steering intervention. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Driver assistance base value
description: Internal value for the head unit's driver assistance displays. The unit offers only one value.
notes: Not a user setting: Nothing reads it: HmiMain3D never queries its id (0xa10) through the variant server, libhmicoding derives no variant from it, and no other binary names it outside the syset tools; one value only.

name: Speed limit offset below limit (km/h)
description: Sets the largest offset below the detected speed limit, in km/h, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

name: Speed limit offset above limit (km/h)
description: Sets the largest offset above the detected speed limit, in km/h, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

name: Speed limit offset below limit (mph)
description: Sets the largest offset below the detected speed limit, in mph, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

name: Speed limit offset above limit (mph)
description: Sets the largest offset above the detected speed limit, in mph, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

name: Right-of-way / junction warning (VORFAHRTSWARNUNG)
description: Enables the right-of-way warning at junctions, alerting the driver to cross-traffic when they may not have right of way.
notes: VORFAHRTSWARNUNG = right-of-way/priority warning (Vorfahrt = right of way). Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV, 1:GEN_1, 2:GEN_2}. Default 0x00 = NICHT_AKTIV.

name: Side collision warning min. speed (km/h)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which side collision warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Reversing Assistant
description: Shows the Reversing Assistant in the head unit's parking displays. Enable it only when the car has Reversing Assistant.

name: Side collision warning min. speed (mph)
description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which side collision warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

name: Intelligent Safety deactivation notice
description: Sets the notice the central display shows when Intelligent Safety systems are switched off or reduced: a general notice that at least one system is deactivated, or one that names the change, such as “Lane Departure Warning deactivated.” It only takes effect when “Lane departure warning version” (`300A/1/00001100b`) is set to generation 2.

name: Front collision warning (FRONTKOLLISIONSWARNUNG)
description: Enables the front collision warning, which alerts the driver to an imminent front-end collision with a vehicle or obstacle ahead.
notes: FRONTKOLLISIONSWARNUNG = front collision warning. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Unintended vehicle movement prevention (ANFAHRVERHINDERUNG)
description: Enables the unintended vehicle movement prevention feature — the system that prevents inadvertent vehicle motion from a standstill.
notes: ANFAHRVERHINDERUNG = prevention of unintended vehicle motion (Anfahren = starting/moving off, Verhinderung = prevention). Enum value_map: {1:GEN_1}. Value 0 has no symbolic name. GEN_1 is the only active value.

name: Speed/velocity assistant (SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT)
description: Enables the speed-management component of the driving assistant, which monitors vehicle speed and assists with speed management.
notes: SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT = compound token combining English 'SPEED' prefix with German GESCHWINDIGKEIT (speed/velocity) + ASSISTENT. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Route / road profile data use (STRECKENVERLAUF)
description: Enables the use of road/route profile data (from navigation) by the driving assistant to anticipate curves and road conditions ahead.
notes: STRECKENVERLAUF = route profile / road layout ahead (Strecke = route/road, Verlauf = progression/profile). Used by predictive safety systems. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Lane change assist (SPURWECHSELASSISTENT)
description: Enables the active lane change assist function, which supports the driver in performing safe lane changes.
notes: SPURWECHSELASSISTENT = lane-change assistant. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Narrow passage assist (ENGSTELLENASSISTENT)
description: Enables the narrow passage / tight-space assistant, which provides visual/audible guidance when passing through narrow gaps or tight spots.
notes: ENGSTELLENASSISTENT = narrow-passage assistant (Engstelle = bottleneck/narrow space). Enum value_map: {1:GEN_1}. Value 0 has no symbolic name.

name: Steering wheel LED indicator (LENKRADLED)
description: Enables LED indicators on the steering wheel rim used to provide haptic/visual driving assistant alerts (e.g. lane departure, collision warnings).
notes: LENKRADLED = steering wheel (Lenkrad) LED. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Manual trailer detection (ANHAENGER_MANUELL)
description: Enables manual trailer detection mode, where the driver confirms trailer presence rather than having it detected automatically.
notes: ANHAENGER_MANUELL = manual trailer (Anhänger = trailer, Manuell = manual). Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV}. Only one documented value.

name: Trailer info display (ANHAENGER_INFO)
description: Enables display of trailer-related information in the Driving Assistant / HMI when a trailer is detected or connected.
notes: ANHAENGER_INFO = trailer information. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Speed assistant (GESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT)
description: Enables the speed assistant function — a speed management/advisory system in the Driving Assistant page.
notes: GESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT = speed/velocity assistant. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Distinct from SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT at byte 11.

name: Intersection / cross-traffic warning (KREUZUNGSWARNUNG)
description: Enables the intersection warning function, which detects and alerts to cross-traffic at junctions.
notes: KREUZUNGSWARNUNG = intersection/crossing warning (Kreuzung = intersection). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Speed limit info display (SPEEDLIMITINFO)
description: Enables the speed limit information display on the HU, showing the current road speed limit derived from camera or map data.
notes: SPEEDLIMITINFO = speed limit information. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Predictive look-ahead (VORAUSSCHAU)
description: Enables predictive look-ahead functionality, where navigation/camera data about the road ahead is used to anticipate and pre-condition driving assistant systems.
notes: VORAUSSCHAU = look-ahead / predictive preview (Vorausschau = anticipation/foresight). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Speed limit warning
description: Tells the head unit which version of speed limit warning the car has, so the Speed Assistant settings describe it correctly. The warning alerts the driver when the car is faster than the detected or chosen limit. With generation 1 the settings describe a warning above the adjusted limit, the detected limit plus the driver's offset. Set it to match the car's equipment.

name: Speed limit staging animation (SPEEDLIMITINSZENIERUNG)
description: Configures the animation/staging displayed when a new speed limit is detected or when the speed limit warning triggers.
notes: SPEEDLIMITINSZENIERUNG = speed-limit staging/presentation. INSZENIERUNG = staging/animation concept. Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV, 1:GEN_1}.

name: Single-side pass-through guidance (EINSEITIGVORBEIFAHREN)
description: Enables single-sided passing assistance — guidance when the vehicle passes a stationary obstacle or parked car where only one side has sufficient clearance.
notes: EINSEITIGVORBEIFAHREN = single-sided passing (Einseitig = one-sided, Vorbeifahren = driving past). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

description: Sets how far the driver can shift the speed limit functions above or below the detected limit in the Speed Assistant settings. With “Not set” the ±15 km/h or ±10 mph range applies.

description: Enables manual mode for the Speed Limit Assist (SLA) — allowing the driver to manually set the reference speed instead of relying on sign recognition.
notes: SLAMANUELL = Speed Limit Assist manual mode (SLA = Speed Limit Assist; Manuell = manual). Enum value_map: {1:GEN_1}. Value 0 has no symbolic name. Previous version notes incorrectly suggested SLA = Stauassistent (traffic jam assistant) — in this context SLA = Speed Limit Assist, consistent with surrounding SPEEDLIMITINFO, SPEEDLIMITWARNUNG tokens.

name: Driving Assistant staging concept (FAS_INSZENIERUNG)
description: Selects the visual staging/animation concept for the Driving Assistant (FAS = Fahrerassistenzsystem). Controls the presentation style of warnings including staging boards, preview, or full visual concept.
notes: FAS_INSZENIERUNG = Driving Assistant system (FAS = Fahrerassistenzsystem) staging concept. Enum value_map: {1:INSZENIERUNGSTAFELN, 2:SARAH_VORSTUFE, 3:SARAH_VOLLKONZEPT, 4:SARAH_VOLLKONZEPT_MINI}. Value 0 has no symbolic name.

description: Master enable bit for the lane change warning (blind spot warning style) function in the SARAH subsystem.
notes: LANE_CHANGE_WARNING = English-language token. No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]). Related to SPURWECHSELWARNUNG.

name: Brake assistant (BRAKE_ASSISTENT)
description: Enables the base brake assistant function, which provides braking support in emergency situations by maximising braking force.
notes: BRAKE_ASSISTENT = brake assistant (note: German-style spelling). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).
