name: Brake assistant 3 / Stop-and-Go (BRAKE_ASSISTENT_3)
description: Enables the third-generation brake assistant function integrated with Active Cruise Control Stop-and-Go capability, providing enhanced automated braking support.
notes: BRAKE_ASSISTENT_3 = brake assistant generation 3. Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV, 1:AKTIV}.

fa_gate: NOT 5AD Lane departure warning / 5DF Active cruise control with Stop&Go function / 5AS Driving Assistant
name: Brake assistant CCM (BRAKE_ASSISTANT_CCM)
description: Enables the Camera / Cross-traffic Monitor (CCM) variant of the brake assistant. Active when NOT equipped with lane departure warning / ACC Stop&Go / Driving Assistant (different sensor set).
notes: BRAKE_ASSISTANT_CCM = brake assistant CCM variant (Camera/Cross-traffic Monitor). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Brake assistant FCW (forward collision warning) (BRAKE_ASSISTANT_FCW)
description: Enables the Forward Collision Warning variant of the brake assistant, which combines camera-based collision detection with automatic pre-braking preparation.
notes: BRAKE_ASSISTANT_FCW = brake assistant Forward Collision Warning. Enum value_map: {0:NICHT_AKTIV, 1:AKTIV}.

name: Lane departure warning enable (LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING)
description: Master enable for the lane departure warning system. When active, the system monitors lane markings and alerts the driver if the vehicle drifts across them without signalling.
notes: LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING = English-language token (master enable, byte 49). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Night Vision 2 object detection (NIVI_2_OBJ_DETECTION)
description: Enables second-generation Night Vision (NIVI 2) object detection, which uses the thermal/night camera to identify and classify objects (pedestrians, animals) in darkness.
notes: NIVI_2_OBJ_DETECTION = Night Vision 2 object detection (NIVI = Nachtsicht/Night Vision). No symbolic enum names in descriptor (raw codes [1]).

name: Touch Command page enable flag
description: Anonymous boolean flag at bit 0 of the TOUCH_COMMAND coding page (page 300B). Exact function not individually pinned in firmware symbol table; likely a master enable or reserved bit for the Touch Command staging block.
notes: Token is positional ('TOUCH_COMMAND byte 0 (boolean flag)'), not a named field. No resolved_unnamed entry. Bit 0 of page byte 0 — likely a global TC page enable or spare; firmware string pool does not resolve individual bit-within-byte positions.

name: Panoramic roof type
description: Declares whether the vehicle has a single-panel or two-panel panoramic glass roof. Tells the Touch Command subsystem which sunroof control UI to present.
notes: Token TC_PANORAMADACH; EINTEILIG=one-piece, ZWEITEILIG=two-piece. Value 0 (neither) = no panoramic roof. Both symbolic names confirmed in syset_enum_values value_map.

name: Sliding/tilting sunroof present
description: Indicates whether the vehicle has a conventional sliding/tilting sunroof (Schiebehebedach). Enables the corresponding Touch Command UI tile.
notes: Token TC_SCHIEBEHEBEDACH (Schiebehebedach = slide-tilt roof). No symbolic enum names in descriptor; single valid code=1.

name: Air ionisation present
description: Enables the air ionisation (ionizer) control tile in the Touch Command screen. Set when the vehicle is equipped with the cabin air ionisation system.
notes: Token TC_IONISATION. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Four-zone climate control present
description: Indicates the vehicle has a 4-zone automatic climate control system. Activates the corresponding extended climate UI in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_CLIMATE_4_ZONES. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear extended climate control present
description: Indicates the vehicle has a rear-area extended climate control zone (beyond standard 2-zone rear). Enables additional rear climate controls in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_CLIMATE_REAR_EXTENDED. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear window roller blind present
description: Indicates whether the vehicle has a rear window roller sun blind. Enables the rear-curtain control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_REAR_WINDOW_CURTAIN; value_map has only {0:NICHT_AKTIV}; value 1 (active) implied by single-bit field pattern. Confidence downgraded from high to med: only one symbolic enum value present (value 0), value 1 is inferred not confirmed by syset descriptor.

name: Rear and side window roller blinds present
description: Indicates the vehicle has roller sun blinds on both rear and side windows. Enables the combined rear+side curtain control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_REAR_AND_SIDE_WINDOW_CURTAIN; value_map {1:AKTIV} only; value 0 not named in descriptor. Confidence set to med: only one symbolic value (1=AKTIV) confirmed.

name: Captain's chairs (individual rear seats) present
description: Indicates the vehicle has individual rear captain's chairs rather than a bench seat. Enables the individual rear-seat control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_CAPTAINCHAIR. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Front seat multifunction controls present
description: Indicates the front seats have multifunction memory/position controls (e.g. easy-entry, memory recall). Enables front seat control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear seat multifunction controls present
description: Indicates the rear seats have multifunction electric adjustment controls. Enables rear seat control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear seat massage present
description: Indicates the rear seats are equipped with a massage function. Enables the rear seat massage control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_REAR_MASSAGE. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Front seat massage present
description: Indicates the front seats are equipped with a massage function. Enables the front seat massage control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_FRONT_MASSAGE. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Front seat lumbar support present
description: Indicates the front seats are equipped with adjustable lumbar (lordosis) support. Enables the lumbar adjustment control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE; LORDOSE = lumbar/lordosis support. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Seat training/dynamic support present
description: Indicates the seats are equipped with dynamic seat / training function (active back support that shifts during cornering). Enables seat training control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_TRAINING. BMW 'seat training' = dynamic seat (pro active seats). No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Front seat heating present
description: Indicates the front seats have heated seat elements. Enables the front seat heating control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_HEATING_FRONT. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear seat heating present
description: Indicates the rear seats have heated seat elements. Enables the rear seat heating control tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_HEATING_REAR. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Front seat ventilation present
description: Indicates the front seats have ventilated/cooled seat elements. Enables the front seat ventilation tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_FRONT. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Rear seat ventilation present
description: Indicates the rear seats have ventilated/cooled seat elements. Enables the rear seat ventilation tile in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Seat auto-climate function present
description: Indicates the seat climate system supports an automatic/combined heating+ventilation mode. Enables the seat auto-climate control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Individual special equipment (SA) mode
description: Signals that the vehicle uses an individual/single special-equipment (Einzel-SA) configuration for Touch Command staging, rather than a bundled package. May affect which TC tiles are shown.
notes: Token TC_EINZEL_SA; EINZEL=individual/single, SA=Sonderausstattung (special equipment). No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Bowers & Wilkins high-end audio staging
description: Controls the Touch Command staging level for the Bowers & Wilkins (B&W) Diamond/high-end audio system. Determines whether the audio system gets no menu, basic display, light animation only, or full introduction staging.

values.1: Display without introduction (KEINE_INSZ — show but skip animation)
values.2: Light animation only (NUR_LICHTINSZ — ambient lighting intro only)
values.3: Full introduction staging (VOLLE_INSZ — full light + sound intro)

notes: Token TC_HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W (B und W = Bowers & Wilkins). KEIN_MENUE/KEINE_INSZ/NUR_LICHTINSZ/VOLLE_INSZ are staging level names from syset descriptor. Default=0 (no menu).

name: Illuminated panoramic roof staging
description: Controls whether the illuminated panoramic roof (Beleuchtetes Panoramadach) is presented in Touch Command and whether its lighting is linked to the ambient interior lighting system.

values.0: Not active (NICHT_AKTIV — no illuminated panoramic roof)
values.1: Active (AKTIV — illuminated roof present, independent control)
values.2: Active with ambient light coupling (AKTIV_MIT_KOPPLUNG_AN_AMBIENTES_INNENLICHT — roof light synced to ambient lighting)

notes: Token TC_BELEUCHTETES_PANORAMADACH (beleuchtetes=illuminated, Panoramadach=panoramic roof). Full enum names from syset descriptor.

name: Light sword (Lichtschwert) ambient strip present
description: Indicates the vehicle has the 'Lichtschwert' (lit. light sword) illuminated ambient door strip feature. Enables the corresponding ambient lighting control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_LICHTSCHWERT; Lichtschwert = BMW ambient lighting strip feature (illuminated door/dash strip). No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Individual ambient lighting present
description: Indicates the vehicle has the Individual ambient interior lighting package (colour-selectable ambient light). Enables individual ambient light colour control in Touch Command.
notes: Token TC_INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT (Ambientelicht=ambient light). No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Colour switch ensemble count
description: Configures the colour-switch ensemble variant for the ambient lighting system. Raw numeric field; exact meaning of each value is not symbolically named in the syset descriptor.
notes: Token TC_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE. Raw numeric field, valid codes 0–4; no symbolic enum names in syset descriptor. The description avoids speculating on zone-count interpretation since it is not supported by any enum name or firmware trace.

name: Ambient light brightness control present
description: Indicates the ambient lighting system supports user-adjustable brightness (Helligkeit). Enables the brightness slider in the Touch Command ambient lighting page.
notes: Token TC_HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT; Helligkeit=brightness, Ambilight=ambient light. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: WLAN hotspot tile present
description: Enables the Wi-Fi hotspot control tile in Touch Command, allowing the driver to enable/disable the in-car WLAN hotspot from the touchscreen.
notes: Token TC_WLAN_HOTSPOT. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Diagnostics/test mode tile present
description: Enables a diagnostics or test mode tile in the Touch Command screen. Intended for workshop or factory use; not typically enabled in production vehicles.
notes: Token TC_DIAGNOSE_TEST_MODE. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Number of Touch Command panels
description: Configures how many Touch Command control panels (TC screens) are available in the iDrive menu. TC_0 means no TC panel; TC_1 through TC_3 enable increasing numbers of TC panels.
notes: Token TC_NUMBER_OF_TOUCH_COMMAND. Enum names TC_0.TC_3 from syset descriptor.

name: Media library browsing enabled
description: Enables media library browsing (e.g. browse by artist/album/genre) in the Touch Command / entertainment section of the iDrive system.
notes: Token TC_MEDIA_BROWSING. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: V12 engine available
description: Indicates the vehicle is fitted with a V12 engine. May enable V12-specific Touch Command engine display graphics or power/cylinder-deactivation controls.
notes: Token TC_V12_ENGINE_AVAILABLE. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1. Not applicable to the 340i (B58 inline-6).

name: Folder browsing enabled
description: Enables folder-based browsing of USB/storage media in the Touch Command entertainment section, allowing navigation by folder hierarchy rather than media library.
notes: Token TC_FOLDER_BROWSING. No symbolic enum names; single valid code=1.

name: Touch operation of the central display
description: Turns on touch operation of the central display, so the screen responds to taps and swipes as well as to the iDrive Controller. Enable it only when the central display is a touchscreen. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609) or TV function (S601).

name: Rear-seat entertainment touchscreen present
description: Indicates the vehicle has a touch-capable display for the Rear Seat Entertainment (RSE) system. Enables RSE touch input handling.
notes: Token CID_HMI_TOUCH_RSE; RSE=Rear Seat Entertainment. Value_map {0:NICHT_AKTIV, 1:AKTIV} — both values symbolically confirmed.

name: Touch Command page — reserved/unknown 6-bit field
description: Anonymous 6-bit field occupying bits 7–2 of byte 5 in the TOUCH_COMMAND coding page. Exact function not individually pinned in firmware symbol table.
notes: Token is positional ('TOUCH_COMMAND byte 5 (6-bit field (00.00))'), not a named syset field. No resolved_unnamed entry. No symbolic enum. Likely padding or a not-yet-assigned field block.

name: Touch Command page — extended/multi-byte data block (bytes 6–29)
description: Anonymous multi-byte region spanning bytes 6–29 of the TOUCH_COMMAND coding page (24 bytes). Likely contains TL_ID (Telefon/Telematik/Online) configuration table entries and other extended Touch Command parameters not individually named.
notes: Token is positional ('TOUCH_COMMAND byte 6 (multi-byte value (syset Int/UInt8/16)'). The cur_desc page summary mentions TL_ID TELEFON_TELEMATIK_ONLINE CONFIG_TABLE_0.10, SPEECH_2_TEXT, PIM_*, A4A_WIRELESS_IOS, PHONE_RSE, SWUP_SOURCE_ONLINE/SEPARATE_UPDATES, WLAN_STATUS/CHANNEL_1.4, API_USB_VIDEO/IPOD_2WIRE/MP4 as fields on this page — those are almost certainly packed into this region. No individual field names resolved.

name: HUD sport display enable
description: Enables the sport-display content group in the head-up display (HUD). When active, sport-oriented readouts are available for the driver to select in HUD settings.
notes: HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_ENABLE — SPORTANZEIGE = sport display.

name: HUD sport display — FES variant
description: Enables the FES (Fahrerassistenz — driver assistance) variant of the HUD sport display. Typically associated with assistance-oriented sport content in the HUD on FES-equipped cars.
notes: HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_FES_ENABLE — FES = Fahrerassistenz (driver assistance).

name: HUD sport display — motorsport lane view
description: Enables the MS_GASSE (motorsport lane/corridor) sport-display variant in the HUD, showing a dynamic lane or corridor graphic during spirited driving or on track.
notes: HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_MS_GASSE_ENABLE — MS = Motorsport, GASSE = lane/corridor.

name: HUD entertainment list
description: Enables the entertainment content list (audio source, track, station) as a selectable content group in the head-up display.
notes: HUD_ENTERTAINMENTLIST — ENT = entertainment, LIST = list. Previous name 'HUD entertainment info display' was unfaithful to the LIST suffix; corrected to 'HUD entertainment list'.

name: HUD distance/following-distance info
description: Enables ACC (adaptive cruise) following-distance information as a selectable content element in the HUD, showing the set gap to the vehicle ahead.
notes: HUD_DISTANCE_INFO.

name: HUD settings: BMW M version
description: Switches the head-up display settings on the central display to their BMW M version. For BMW M models with a head-up display.

name: HUD content: turn signals
description: When enabled, the head-up display also indicates when a turn signal is on.

name: HUD traffic sign recognition display
description: Enables display of recognised traffic signs (speed limits, no-passing signs, etc.) from the vehicle's camera-based sign recognition (VZA) system in the head-up display.
notes: HUD_VZA — VZA = Verkehrszeichenanzeige (traffic sign display).

name: HUD image compression
description: Image compression the head unit uses for navigation graphics in the head-up display and cluster. It must match the hardware generation.
notes: Not a user setting: Display-link encoding: NavNBTEvoController maps RLE_1 (Capricorn/Bosch/L6/FPK) / RLE_2 (Jade/Conti/L7) to the NBT_RLE32 (Bosch) or NBT_RLE16 (Conti) compressor for the guidance-viewer (ICHUD) maneuver graphics; it only has to match the receiving hardware, like LVDS tuning. A mismatch breaks the graphics rather than giving a different result.

name: HUD image rotation
description: Enables rotation of the HUD display image, used to compensate for optical path geometry when the projector unit requires a rotated raster.
notes: HUD_ROTATION.

name: HUD position adjustment available
description: Enables the user-accessible position adjustment function for the HUD. When set, the system supports HUD position control (used in conjunction with the specific slider controls in bytes 9-10).
notes: HUD_POSITION. Distinct from HUD_SLIDE_HOEHE (byte 10 bit0) and HUD_SLIDE_ROTATION (byte 10 bit1) which enable specific slider UI controls.

name: HUD activation (fitted/activated)
description: Marks the HUD as activated/enabled in the system — the primary fitment activation bit distinct from HUD_VERBAUT. When set, the head-up display subsystem initialises and presents HUD-related menus.
notes: HUD_ACTIVATION.

name: HUD speed control display
description: Enables display of the active speed control set-speed (cruise control or speed limiter) as a content element in the HUD. The named firmware value NICHT_AKTIV (not active) is the default/off state.
notes: HUD_SPEEDCONTROL — SPEEDCONTROL covers both cruise control (Tempomat) and speed limiter; previous name 'HUD cruise-control speed display' incorrectly asserted cruise-control specifically. Corrected to 'HUD speed control display'.

name: Navigation HUD available
description: Declares that navigation turn-by-turn content is available for display in the HUD on this vehicle. Enables routing instructions (arrows, distance to manoeuvre) in the HUD.
notes: NAVI_HUD_AVAILABLE.

name: Junction View in HUD
description: Enables the Junction View (detailed intersection guidance graphic) to be shown in the HUD in addition to or instead of the standard navigation arrow. Requires Navigation HUD to be available.
notes: JUNCTION_VIEW_HUD — NICHT_AKTIV (0) = not active (named in firmware descriptor).

name: Head-up display installed
description: Tells the head unit a head-up display (HUD) is installed, which enables the HUD menus and settings. Enable it only when the car has a HUD.

name: Undocumented field (HUD_RES)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Although 'RES' superficially suggests resolution, a dedicated resolution field (HUD_AUFLOESUNG) already exists at byte 3; RES most likely denotes a reserved or unspecified field. No enum values are defined.
notes: HUD_RES — 'RES' interpreted as reserved (not resolution) because HUD_AUFLOESUNG at byte 3 already covers HUD resolution; having two separate resolution fields in adjacent bytes would be redundant. No enum names in firmware descriptor.

name: HUD hardware generation
description: Selects the generation of the HUD projector hardware fitted. Used by the system to select correct display parameters, calibration, and feature support for the installed unit.
notes: HUD_GENERATION — 3-bit numeric enum; no symbolic names in the firmware descriptor. Default 0.

name: HUD content: junction view (day)
description: Setting for the junction view in the head-up display, for daytime. Best left unchanged.

name: HUD image resolution
description: Sets the image resolution the head unit uses for navigation graphics in the head-up display, to suit the HUD generation. Best left unchanged.

name: HUD radio-button (content selector) configuration
description: Selects which radio-button layout/set is presented in the HUD content selector (the on-screen control that lets the driver choose what to display). KEINE_RADIOBUTTONS means no radio-button selector is shown.
notes: HUD_RB_KONFIGURATION — RB = Radiobutton, KONFIGURATION = configuration. Default field value 2 = KEINE_RADIOBUTTONS (only named symbolic value from cur_desc).

name: HUD/cluster display dwell time
description: Sets how long a HUD/instrument-cluster popup or notification is shown before automatically dismissing. The only named firmware value is WERT_1_250MS (value 1 = 250 ms); higher values select longer dwell times.
notes: DISPLAYTIME_LIST_HUD_KOMBI — 3-bit enum; WERT_1_250MS (value 1) is the only named entry from cur_desc. KOMBI = instrument cluster.

name: HUD checkbox: on/off control
description: Enables the master on/off checkbox in the HUD section of the iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to completely enable or disable the head-up display.
notes: HUD_CB_EIN_AUS — CB = Checkbox, EIN = on, AUS = off.

name: HUD checkbox: showroom mode
description: Enables the showroom/demonstration mode checkbox in HUD settings. When active, the HUD can be operated in showroom mode for dealer demonstration purposes.
notes: HUD_CB_SHOWROOM_MODE.

name: HUD menu: Check Control checkbox
description: Adds a Check Control checkbox to the head-up display settings, letting the driver choose whether Check Control messages, the car's warning and status notices, also appear in the HUD.

name: HUD checkbox: content list
description: Enables a content-list selection checkbox in the HUD iDrive settings, allowing the driver to toggle which content categories appear in the HUD display list.
notes: HUD_CB_LISTEN — LISTEN = lists (German plural).

name: HUD checkbox: speed limit display
description: Enables the speed-limit (Tempolimit) checkbox in the HUD iDrive settings, letting the driver choose whether the current speed limit is shown in the HUD.
notes: HUD_CB_TEMPOLIMIT — TEMPOLIMIT = speed limit.

name: HUD checkbox: following-distance info
description: Enables the Abstandsinfo (following-distance information) checkbox in HUD settings, letting the driver choose whether ACC gap-to-vehicle-ahead is shown in the HUD.
notes: HUD_CB_ABSTANDSINFO — ABSTANDSINFO = following-distance information.

name: HUD checkbox: speed-limit info
description: Enables the speed-limit-info checkbox in HUD iDrive settings (distinct from the alert/warning variant; may relate to advisory/road-sign-sourced speed limit display).
notes: HUD_CB_SPEEDLIMITINFO. Related to but distinct from HUD_CB_TEMPOLIMIT.

name: Undocumented field (HUD byte 5 high 6 bits)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. This 6-bit field occupies bits 7-2 of HUD page byte 5; the firmware descriptor names this page but does not assign a token to this specific (byte,mask) combination. No enum values are defined.
notes: Token in input is a positional placeholder. Not in syset_enum_values (page 300C has no entries). No resolved_unnamed entry. Default empty.

name: Undocumented field (HUD bytes 6-8 multi-byte)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. This is a multi-byte value spanning bytes 6-8 of the HUD coding page; the firmware descriptor names the page but does not assign a token to this specific field.
notes: Token in input is a positional placeholder. Not in syset_enum_values. No resolved_unnamed entry. Default empty.

name: HUD standstill view enable
description: Enables a static/standstill display view in the HUD when the vehicle is at a standstill. Controls whether the HUD shows content while stationary (sub-bits in this byte select which content).
notes: HUD_STANDANSICHT — STAND = standstill/stationary, ANSICHT = view.

name: HUD standstill view: no display
description: When the HUD standstill view is active, this bit selects 'no content' (blank) as the standstill screen, overriding other standstill content bits.
notes: HUD_STAND_KEINE_ANZEIGE — KEINE_ANZEIGE = no display.

name: HUD standstill view: navigation
description: Selects navigation content (e.g. destination, next manoeuvre) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary.
notes: HUD_STAND_NAVIGATION.

name: HUD standstill view: efficiency/EfficientDynamics
description: Selects EfficientDynamics/efficiency data (e.g. current range, energy flow) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary.
notes: HUD_STAND_EFFIZIENZ — EFFIZIENZ = efficiency.

name: HUD standstill view: calendar/appointments
description: Selects calendar appointments (Termine) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary, showing upcoming calendar events.
notes: HUD_STAND_TERMINE — TERMINE = appointments/calendar events.

name: Undocumented field (HUD byte 9 bits 6-5)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. This 2-bit field occupies bits 6-5 of HUD page byte 9; no token is assigned in the firmware descriptor for this specific (byte,mask).
notes: Token in input is a positional placeholder. Not in syset_enum_values. No resolved_unnamed entry.

name: HUD brightness slider
description: Enables the brightness adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to manually adjust HUD image brightness.
notes: HUD_SLIDE_HELLIGKEIT — SLIDE = slider control, HELLIGKEIT = brightness.

name: HUD height adjustment slider
description: Enables the height (Hoehe) adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to raise or lower the projected HUD image to suit their seating position.
notes: HUD_SLIDE_HOEHE — HOEHE = height.

name: HUD rotation adjustment slider
description: Enables the rotation/tilt adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to correct the rotational angle of the projected HUD image.
notes: HUD_SLIDE_ROTATION.

name: Undocumented field (HUD byte 10 bits 7-2)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. This 6-bit field occupies bits 7-2 of HUD page byte 10; no token is assigned in the firmware descriptor for this specific (byte,mask).
notes: Token in input is a positional placeholder. Not in syset_enum_values. No resolved_unnamed entry.

name: Undocumented field (HUD bytes 11-79 multi-byte)
description: Purpose not determined from available sources. This is a large multi-byte value spanning bytes 11-79 of the HUD coding page; the firmware descriptor names the page but does not assign a token to this field range. May contain HUD optics calibration or geometry data.
notes: Token in input is a positional placeholder. Covers 69 bytes (11-79) of the 80-byte HUD page. Not in syset_enum_values. No resolved_unnamed entry. Optics calibration/geometry is speculative but noted as a possibility only.

name: Instrument cluster boolean flag (byte 0, bit 0)
description: An unidentified boolean flag in the KOMBI coding page. Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token is a positional descriptor ('KOMBI byte 0 (boolean flag (Bool)'), not a named field. No enum map or resolved_unnamed entry.

fa_gate: NOT 609 Professional navigation system / 6WA KOMBI with extended equipment specification / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31)
name: Cluster MMI list mode (basic)
description: Selects whether the instrument cluster uses a basic/simplified MMI list layout. Enabled when the car lacks a professional navigation system (SA 609) and the high-spec KOMBI variant (6WA).
notes: Token: BASIS_KOMBI_MMI_LIST. BASIS=basic/base, KOMBI=instrument cluster, MMI_LIST=menu list. FA-gated: inactive when 609 or 6WA present. No syset enum map available; single-bit field uses standard on/off.

name: Cluster ECO display (CSC)
description: Setting for efficiency information shown in the instrument cluster (CSC). Best left unchanged.

name: Loupe (magnified needle) speedometer in cluster
description: Enables the loupe/magnified-needle (Lupenzeiger) speedometer display style in the instrument cluster, which renders the speedometer with a large stylized analog needle sweep.
notes: Token: LOUPE_TACHO_KOMBI. LOUPE=magnifying/zoom (Lupenzeiger = magnified needle style), TACHO=speedometer, KOMBI=instrument cluster. Not a digital overlay — refers to the BMW Lupenzeiger analog display style. No syset enum map.

name: Drive mode display in cluster
description: Enables the driving mode (COMFORT/SPORT/ECO PRO) status indicator in the instrument cluster. When active, the selected drive mode is shown in the cluster.
notes: Token: DRIVE_MODE_KOMBI. Related to Driving Experience Control / FAHRMODUSANSICHT feature. No syset enum map.

fa_gate: NOT vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 27 type tokens, e.g. 11CK,11CL,11DE,12CK) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 1; 13 type tokens, e.g. 1H91,1H92,1H93,1J31) / vehicle type-key attribute group (FP category 25; 3 type tokens, e.g. 1J31,1J32,1J33)
name: Calming display mode for cluster
description: Enables the 'calming' visual mode in the instrument cluster, which reduces or simplifies displayed information (associated with Eco Pro mode calm-driving animations). Firmware enum value NICHT_AKTIV = not active.
notes: Token: CALMING_KOMBI. The syset cur_desc lists value NICHT_AKTIV (not active), consistent with a NICHT_AKTIV/AKTIV boolean. FA-gated away on certain market/type-key groups.

name: MFID cluster display variant
description: Selects a variant of the multi-function instrument display (MFID) layout in the cluster. Determines which graphical/content variant of the cluster screen is used.
notes: Token: MFID_KOMBI_VARIANT. MFID=Multi-Function Instrument Display, VARIANT=layout/config selection. No syset enum map; single-bit field.

fa_gate: 606 Navigation system Business / 609 Professional navigation system
name: Navigation guidance switchable in cluster
description: Enables the switchable turn-by-turn navigation guidance display (arrow/maneuver info) in the instrument cluster. Requires a navigation system (SA 606 or 609) to be fitted.
notes: Token: KOMBIGUIDING_SCHALTBAR. KOMBI=cluster, GUIDING=navigation guidance, SCHALTBAR=switchable/togglable. FA gate: 606 or 609 navigation required. No syset enum map.

name: Cluster CIC generation flag
description: 2-bit field relating to the CIC (Car Information Computer) generation compatibility of the instrument cluster. Only one enum value is known from firmware: KOMBI_HIGH (high-specification cluster variant). Other values are not documented.
notes: Token: KOMBI_CIC. CIC=Car Information Computer (iDrive generation). Only one syset enum label known: KOMBI_HIGH. Values 0, 2, 3 have no documented enum names; labeling them 'Reserved' or mapping cluster vs HMI would be fabrication.

name: Units master source
description: Determines which ECU is the master for unit settings (metric/imperial, etc.). Only one enum value is documented from firmware: HMI (iDrive head unit as master). Other values are not individually documented.
notes: Token: EINHEITEN_MASTER. German: Einheiten=units, Master=controlling entity. Only one syset enum label known: HMI. Values 0, 2, 3 have no documented enum names; labeling them 'Cluster master' etc. would be fabrication.

name: Range figures in cluster
description: Chooses which range figures the instrument cluster shows: the minimum range, the maximum range or both. Check only figures the car's cluster can show.

name: Micro map in cluster
description: Enables a small navigation map (mini-map / micromap) overlay in the instrument cluster display. Requires navigation system hardware.
notes: Token: MICROMAP_KOMBI. MICROMAP=small embedded map view, KOMBI=cluster. No syset enum map; single-bit field.

name: Cluster screen resolution type (RES)
description: 2-bit field specifying the display resolution type/class of the instrument cluster screen. No individual enum values are documented for this field from available sources.
notes: Token: KOMBI_RES. RES=resolution. No syset enum map available for this coord. 2-bit numeric field; no per-value symbolic names documented.

name: Cluster resolution switch
description: Setting for the resolution of the navigation map graphics the head unit draws for the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.

name: Welcome jingle request target (WBK)
description: Single-bit field indicating whether the instrument cluster (KOMBI) is the target for the welcome/startup jingle sound. When set, the cluster plays the startup chime.
notes: Token: WBK_JINGLE_REQUEST. WBK=Willkommens-Begruessung-Klang (welcome greeting sound), JINGLE_REQUEST=which ECU plays it. Documented syset enum value: KOMBI.

name: iDrive 5 color set
description: Uses the iDrive 5 color scheme for the navigation map graphics the head unit draws for the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.

name: Instrument cluster 2-bit field (byte 2, bits 7-6)
description: An unidentified 2-bit field in the KOMBI coding page. Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token is positional ('KOMBI byte 2 (2-bit field (00.00))'). No enum map, no resolved_unnamed entry, no firmware trace found.

name: Cluster phone list update delay
description: Sets the short delay the head unit waits before it updates the phone list shown in the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.
notes: Not a user setting: Timing parameter: HmiMain3D reads it as a quantity (a raw x 5 ms timer for the cluster phone list), but timing settings stay hidden (decision 2); the unit's table holds one value only.

name: Cluster hardware variant code (KI)
description: 6-bit code identifying the specific instrument cluster (KI = Kombiinstrument) hardware variant installed. Determines cluster feature set and display capabilities.
notes: Token: KI_KOMBI_VARIANT. KI=Kombiinstrument (instrument cluster), VARIANT=hardware type code. 6-bit numeric field; no syset symbolic per-value map available.

name: Cluster panel configuration (KI Tafel)
description: Configures the instrument cluster panel/display layout (Tafel = panel/board). Controls how the cluster's display area is structured or segmented.
notes: Token: KI_TAFEL_KONFIGURATION. German: Tafel=panel/board, Konfiguration=configuration. No syset enum map; single-bit field. Default 0x01 (on).

name: Cluster brightness control enabled
description: Enables head-unit brightness control for the instrument cluster. When active, the HU can send brightness/backlight level commands to the cluster.
notes: Token: KI_BRIGHTNESS. KI=Kombiinstrument, BRIGHTNESS=backlight/brightness control. No syset enum map; single-bit field. Default 0x01 (enabled).

name: Cluster display mode choices
description: Sets which instrument cluster display modes the driver can pick in the central display's instrument cluster settings: standard, a reduced view that shows less, and an individual view.

name: Cluster checkbox: drive mode view
description: Enables the drive mode view (Fahrmodusansicht) checkbox in the cluster display options, allowing the user to toggle the driving mode indicator in the cluster info area.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_FAHRMODUSANSICHT. KI=cluster, DISP=display, CB=checkbox, FAHRMODUSANSICHT=driving mode view. Default 0x01 (enabled).

name: Cluster checkbox: route overview
description: Enables the route overview (Streckenuebersicht) checkbox in cluster display options, allowing the user to show a simplified route/navigation overview in the cluster.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_STRECKENUEBERSICHT. German: Strecken=route/section, uebersicht=overview. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: additional road signs
description: Enables the additional road sign display checkbox in the cluster, allowing supplementary traffic sign information (e.g. speed limit warnings) to be shown.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_ADDITIONAL_SIGN. ADDITIONAL_SIGN=supplementary road/traffic sign display. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: speedometer needle band
description: Enables the speedometer needle band (Tachozeigerband) display checkbox in the cluster, which shows a colored band or sweep around the analog speedometer needle.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_TACHOZEIGERBAND. German: Tacho=speedometer, Zeiger=needle/pointer, Band=band/strip. Default 0x01.

name: Instrument cluster boolean flag (byte 5, bit 7)
description: An unidentified boolean flag in byte 5 of the KOMBI coding page. Purpose not determined from available sources. Default is 1 (on).
notes: Token is positional ('KOMBI byte 5 (boolean flag (Bool))'). Default 0x01. No enum map or resolved_unnamed entry.

name: Cluster checkbox: M dynamic driving info
description: Enables the M-model dynamic driving information checkbox (Fahrdynamik) in the cluster, making performance metrics (lateral g-force, engine output etc.) available in the cluster display.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_M_FAHRDYNAMIK. M=BMW M variant, FAHRDYNAMIK=driving dynamics. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: Sport Performance Analyzer
description: Enables the Sport Performance Analyzer (SPA) checkbox in the cluster display options. SPA provides real-time performance metrics in the cluster for M/sport vehicles.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_SPA. SPA=Sport Performance Analyzer (BMW M feature). Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: digital speed display
description: Enables the digital speed readout checkbox in the cluster display options, allowing the driver to toggle a numeric speed display alongside or instead of the analog speedometer.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_SPEED_DIGITAL. SPEED_DIGITAL=numerical digital speed readout. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: clock display
description: Enables the clock/time display checkbox in the cluster info area options, allowing the current time to be shown in the instrument cluster.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_CLOCK. CLOCK=time display in cluster. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer (BC) display
description: Enables the trip computer / board computer (BC = Bordcomputer) checkbox in the cluster, making on-board computer info pages (fuel economy, range, etc.) accessible in the cluster.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC. BC=Bordcomputer (trip computer/on-board computer). Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer arrival time and distance
description: Enables the arrival time and remaining distance trip computer fields in the cluster display. These are navigation-integrated BC fields showing ETA and distance to destination.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_ANKUNFTSZEIT_DISTANCE_ENABLE. German: ANKUNFTSZEIT=arrival time, DISTANCE=remaining distance. HMI_BC=HMI-sourced trip computer. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer range display
description: Enables the remaining fuel/energy range field in the cluster trip computer display. Shows estimated driving range remaining.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC_RANGE_ENABLE. BC=Bordcomputer, RANGE=driving range remaining. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: instantaneous fuel consumption (combustion)
description: Enables the real-time/momentary fuel consumption display for the combustion engine in the cluster trip computer. Firmware enum value NICHT_AKTIV = not active (off).
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_VERBRENNER_ENABLE. German: MOM=momentan (instantaneous), VERBR=Verbrauch (consumption), VERBRENNER=combustion engine. Syset enum value NICHT_AKTIV documented for this field; AKTIV implied for value 1. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: instantaneous electric consumption
description: Enables the real-time/momentary electric energy consumption display in the cluster trip computer. Applicable to hybrid/EV vehicles.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_ELEKTR_ENABLE. German: ELEKTR=elektrisch (electric), MOM_VERBR=instantaneous consumption. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: average speed and consumption
description: Enables the average speed and average fuel/energy consumption fields in the cluster trip computer display.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC_AVERAGE_SPEED_CONS_ENABLE. AVERAGE_SPEED_CONS=average speed and consumption. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: engine coolant temperature
description: Enables the engine coolant/oil temperature display checkbox in the cluster trip computer. When active, engine temperature is shown as a BC field.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_MOTOR_TEMP_BC_ENABLE. German: MOTOR_TEMP=engine temperature, BC=Bordcomputer. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: EDA trip counter enable
description: Enables the EDA (abbreviated eco/efficiency display counter) checkbox in the cluster trip computer. EDA full expansion is not confirmed in available sources but is context-consistent with eco-driving efficiency tracking.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_BC_EDA_ENABLE. EDA=abbreviation not individually expanded in firmware (possibly Energiedifferenzanzeige or similar). Default 0x00 (off by default).

name: Cluster checkbox: battery state-of-charge display
description: Enables the high-voltage battery state-of-charge (SOC) display in the cluster trip computer. Relevant for hybrid/EV vehicles.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_SOC_ENABLE. SOC=State of Charge (battery level percentage). Default 0x01.

name: Cluster checkbox: electric trip counter average speed
description: Enables the average speed counter for the electric (EV) trip segment in the cluster trip computer. Tracks average speed over an electric-driving trip.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_E_COUNTER_AVG_SPEED. E_COUNTER=electric trip counter, AVG_SPEED=average speed. Default 0x01.

name: Cluster: average electric energy consumption display
description: Enables display of average electric energy consumption (kWh/100km or similar) in the cluster trip computer area.
notes: Token: KI_DISP_BC_AVG_CONSUMPTION_ELECTRIC. BC=Bordcomputer, AVG_CONSUMPTION_ELECTRIC=average electric energy use. Default 0x01.

name: Instrument cluster boolean flag (byte 7, bit 7)
description: An unidentified boolean flag in byte 7 of the KOMBI coding page. Purpose not determined from available sources.
notes: Token is positional ('KOMBI byte 7 (boolean flag (Bool))'). No enum map or resolved_unnamed entry.

name: Instrument cluster multi-byte data block (byte 8+)
description: A multi-byte data block starting at byte 8 and extending to byte 78 of the KOMBI coding page. This covers HUD radio-button configuration and other cluster parameters not individually decoded. Exact structure not resolved from available sources.
notes: Token: 'KOMBI byte 8 (multi-byte value (syset Int/UInt8/16))'. End byte 78, size 71 bytes. Page-level context mentions HUD_M, HUD_SLIDE_HELLIGKEIT, HUD_CB_{CCM,EIN_AUS,SHOWROOM_MODE}, HUD_TURNSIGNAL, HUD_RB_KONFIGURATION in this span. No individual field map available.
